problem: A verifier can appear robust because optimization barely uses it.
assumption_broken: Absence of discovered exploitation is not evidence of resistance under effective pressure.
operational_signature: measure pressure → vary incentive → control capability → vary oracle access → compare held-out fidelity
load_bearing_mechanism: Four falsifiable interventions separate absent signals, weak pressure, claim selection, and pre-commit access.
limitations_evident: One verifier and generator; six narrow pipeline tasks and short horizons.
Search omits claim counts, limiting the interpretation of absent claim minimization.
Small-pipeline estimator behavior partly confounds observed fidelity declines.

title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
problem: A harness optimized for an earlier policy may miss current failures.
assumption_broken: Policy and harness should adapt through a shared failure-driven interface.
operational_signature: inspect failures → propose harness edits → select → train policy → identify hard tasks → retarget harness search
load_bearing_mechanism: Policy-training failures define the next harness search set and the policy becomes its own proposer.

improver_modified.how: Policy training changes the model used as the next harness proposer, although the search algorithm remains fixed.

limitations_evident: Only two alternating rounds and one base policy are tested.
Evaluation-run variance is reported, not independent evolution-run variance.
An isolated matched-budget old-versus-updated proposer comparison is not established.

title: Evo-B&B: Behavior-Aware LLM-Guided Joint Evolution of Branching and Node Selection Policies for MILP
problem: Joint policy search wastes solver evaluations on behaviorally redundant candidates.
assumption_broken: Code diversity need not imply decision diversity.
operational_signature: generate joint policy → execute solver → compare behavioral signatures → retain Pareto-diverse policies
load_bearing_mechanism: Fixed decision probes measure behavioral redundancy for population admission and parent selection.
limitations_evident: Supplied extraction truncates sections and omits tables or appendices.
Independent whole-search variance and matched optimization cost are not established in the supplied text.

title: When to Forget: Risk-Controlled Context Adaptation for Long-Horizon Agents
problem: Failure histories can become harmful or redundant as execution progresses.
assumption_broken: The same failure block should not always be retained.
operational_signature: compare context interventions → predict useful edits → certify risk constraints → select policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Matched execution comparisons and independent certification constrain context-removal risk.
limitations_evident: Full text unavailable: abstract-only extraction; experimental evidence remains unclear.

title: Reward Engine: Reward-Centric Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Tool Agents
problem: Open-ended tool outputs lack reliable executable rewards.
assumption_broken: Reward construction must be tested and stationary rather than an unchecked moving judge.
operational_signature: draft obligations → bind evidence checks → test counterexamples → preserve prior agreements → freeze and select outputs
load_bearing_mechanism: Regression-gated reward repair preserves accumulated reference judgments while the round uses a frozen pack.
limitations_evident: Reward ordering evaluation may reuse candidates the packs have seen.
Total optimizer cost and equal-budget comparison are not reported.
Reference labels are fallible model judgments; their accuracy is not measured.

title: Self-Evolving Agents Can Repair Failures but Struggle to Generalize from Them
problem: Local recovery can be mistaken for transferable self-improvement.
assumption_broken: Correctly diagnosed failures need not yield reusable capabilities.
operational_signature: isolate failed trajectories → evolve external artifacts → freeze held-out evaluation → intervene on learning signals
load_bearing_mechanism: Failure-only, feedback-blind streams separate task repair from generalization.
limitations_evident: Only finite evolution horizons, up to 800 ALFWorld tasks, are tested.
Failure-dense selected streams restrict deployment generalization.
Supplied extraction truncates causal analyses and does not establish search-seed variance.

title: Darwin-Claw: Environment-Adaptive Experience Consolidation for Recursively Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Uncontrolled trace accumulation obscures useful situational experience.
assumption_broken: All extracted experience need not deserve permanent skill context.
operational_signature: parse new traces → triage experience → assess attributed utility → probation → promote or evict
load_bearing_mechanism: Bounded skill slots and TTL probation govern retention of experience units.
limitations_evident: LLM-based reliance attribution is not a randomized paired-rollout causal estimate.
Disjoint evolution and evaluation tasks are not specified in the supplied text.
Matched computational budget is claimed without separated optimizer-cost accounting.

title: From Trajectories to Differentiated Skills: Cognitive Differentiation for Self-Improving Agents
problem: Monolithic skill artifacts mix behavioral functions with different maintenance needs.
assumption_broken: Artifact boundaries need not define knowledge maintenance and use.
operational_signature: contrast outcomes → ground lessons in traces → assign functional roles → specialized update → coordinate and validate → selective loading
load_bearing_mechanism: Meta, Experience, Tool and Script receive distinct update and validation operators.
limitations_evident: Multi-round experiments reuse a fixed corpus, not a changing environment.
Reported cost focuses on input tokens; end-to-end optimizer budget matching is not established.
Repeated-search seeds and variance are not established by the extraction.

title: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
problem: Monolithic rewriting loses field boundaries and reusable knowledge.
assumption_broken: One unrestricted instruction need not hold all reusable editing strategies.
operational_signature: deploy field-scoped behaviors → observe ranking deltas → propose edits → deduplicate → commit and deactivate → freeze for evaluation
load_bearing_mechanism: Structured field scope and moderated delta operations preserve reusable behavior knowledge.
limitations_evident: Episode reward credits every co-applied behavior, without isolating its causal contribution.
Modified behaviors inherit old counts and cannot be reverted automatically.
Editor and training ranker share GPT-5.4; cross-ranker results are cut off in the extraction.

title: RedDarwin: Evolving Jailbreak Skills against Frontier LLMs
problem: Prompt search leaves attack algorithms fixed.
assumption_broken: The procedure generating test inputs can itself be revised and recombined.
operational_signature: select procedures → revise or compose → execute → compare development fitness → retain → freeze and transfer
load_bearing_mechanism: A common executable skill interface makes algorithmic control flow an evolutionary target.
limitations_evident: Matched target-query budgets do not establish matched full evolutionary optimizer cost.
Search-seed variance is not established in the supplied text.
One unseen target shares a model family with a development target.

title: DrugHarness: An Evolvable Agent Harness for Computational Drug Discovery
problem: Scientific experience can yield poorly scoped or unverified action guidance.
assumption_broken: Recommendations need observable conditions and reviewed evidence rather than generic reuse.
operational_signature: compare experience → induce conditional hypothesis → construct skill → independent source and execution review → admit → revise from feedback
load_bearing_mechanism: Independent review gates condition-scoped skills using scientific sources and targeted trials.
limitations_evident: Evolution gains are retrospective on skill-development tasks, with historical no-skill controls.
Prospective wet-lab validation does not isolate an evolved-skill benefit.
Matched cost comparisons and unseen-task evolution evaluation remain future work.

title: Second-Order Problem Solving for Recursive Self-Improvement in Formal Verification
problem: Symptom-driven workflow patches recur or contradict earlier edits.
assumption_broken: The failure mechanism should be investigated rather than inferred from its visible symptom.
operational_signature: monitor traces → detect structural anomalies → probe causal hypotheses → edit workflow → validate and retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Executable diagnostic probes and persistent inquiry records guide mechanism-level workflow edits.
limitations_evident: Evaluation covers Lean and Verus rather than arbitrary agent environments.

title: HERA: Harness-Environment Co-Evolution for Reliable Agentic Abstention
problem: Fixed feasible and infeasible task pools leave abstention harnesses brittle to new failure modes.
assumption_broken: The training environment can evolve together with the harness.
operational_signature: construct verified task pairs → run harness → diagnose failures → mutate environments and harness → evaluate
load_bearing_mechanism: Failure-conditioned generation of feasible/infeasible task pairs co-evolves with harness adaptation.
limitations_evident: Synthetic environments may not cover deployment infeasibility.

title: SkillPoison: Progressive Skill Poisoning via Successful Experiences
problem: Verified successful trajectories can still induce harmful reusable skills.
assumption_broken: Task correctness of a source experience does not certify safe generalization of its extracted skill.
operational_signature: select successful experiences → reinforce a locally valid behavior → remove contextual restrictions → induce skill formation → test misuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-experience reinforcement causes native skill extraction to overgeneralize a locally correct behavior.
limitations_evident: The attack depends on access to the experience-to-skill formation channel.

title: Joint Workflow and Prompt Optimization for User Behavior Simulation
problem: Hand-crafted user simulators and separately optimized workflows or prompts transfer poorly.
assumption_broken: Workflow structure and component prompts should be optimized jointly.
operational_signature: sample role workflows → execute simulations → compute error → attribute textual feedback → revise prompts and topology
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint updates account for the dependence of a prompt's feedback on its position in the workflow.
limitations_evident: Experiments focus on user-behavior simulation tasks.

title: Learning from Revision Consequences: Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation for Self-Improving Agents
problem: Branch outcomes confound the quality of a meta-skill revision with its starting discovery state.
assumption_broken: The consequence of changing the improvement procedure can be measured from a restored shared state.
operational_signature: restore discovery state → replay incumbent and revised meta-skills → contrast outcomes → distill meta-experience → revise future meta-skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Matched-state hindsight replay supplies revision-specific evidence for learning meta-skills.

improver_modified.how: The retained meta-skill changes how subsequent task skills are discovered and revised.

limitations_evident: Matched comparisons require both continuations to complete normally; constructing meta-experience requires paired re-execution.

title: Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?
problem: Familiar game rules confound interaction learning with pretrained knowledge.
assumption_broken: Agent learning should be measured in newly designed hidden-rule environments.
operational_signature: generate unfamiliar games → repeat interactions → retain experience under alternative harnesses → vary instances → compare learning
load_bearing_mechanism: Novel and counterintuitive rules with automatic scoring isolate knowledge acquisition from prior familiarity.
limitations_evident: Main experiments use one fixed seed per game template.

title: MedZERO: Self-Evolving Agents for Open-Ended Medical Reasoning Through Controlled Knowledge Accumulation
problem: Open-ended medical reasoning lacks the exact verification used by common self-evolution loops.
assumption_broken: Partially verifiable medical tasks can support curriculum co-evolution with controlled knowledge retention.
operational_signature: generate frontier questions → reason with evidence tools → filter exploratory knowledge → train examiner and reasoner → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Alternating examiner-reasoner training combines frontier generation with ephemeral-to-persistent knowledge accumulation.
limitations_evident: Medical knowledge and open-ended answers are only partially verifiable.

title: EMHO: EMbodied Agent Harness Optimization via Experience Traces
problem: Embodied harness design remains manual despite useful execution traces.
assumption_broken: The full interaction harness can change while the embodied model stays frozen.
operational_signature: execute episodes → inspect traces and harness history → revise runtime → compare subtask gains and losses → retain refinement
load_bearing_mechanism: Trace-grounded edits alter observation, progress monitoring and tool use beyond failure-recovery prompts.
limitations_evident: Search-set improvements can diverge from held-out performance.

title: Agent Plasticity: Measuring Self-Improvement Through Experience
problem: Static endpoint scores do not measure how efficiently agents improve from experience.
assumption_broken: Learning cost and held-out gains are distinct from endpoint capability.
operational_signature: run fixed-weight lineages → inherit artifacts → evaluate ID and OOD checkpoints → account for learning cost → diagnose reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Agent plasticity measures held-out improvement per learning cost while tracking inherited artifact use.
limitations_evident: OOD transfer is partial and high artifact reuse need not imply useful artifacts.

title: Verify Less, Evolve More: Training Idea-Level Critics for Verification-Efficient ML Evolving Agents
problem: Expensive empirical training limits how many proposed ML modifications can be verified.
assumption_broken: A specialized learned critic can screen ideas before executing them.
operational_signature: collect labeled modification critiques → train critic → rank proposed changes → verify promising or uncertain changes → update search
load_bearing_mechanism: Idea-level critics concentrate costly empirical verification on promising modifications.
limitations_evident: A predicted improvement remains a proxy for empirical evaluation.

title: RLDISCOVER: LLM-driven co-evolution of reinforcement learning algorithms
problem: Coupled RL components and noisy training make algorithm evolution expensive.
assumption_broken: Algorithm components and evaluation fidelity can be evolved rather than fixed.
operational_signature: edit individual components → co-evolve coupled components → screen at staged fidelities → repeat across seeds → retain programs
load_bearing_mechanism: Progressive co-evolution and probabilistic multi-fidelity evaluation balance candidate breadth and reliability.
limitations_evident: Fitness varies substantially across training seeds.

title: RSI-Forge: From Research Papers to Environments for Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Executable research environments with reliable baselines depend on scarce domain expertise.
assumption_broken: Published methods can be converted into reproducible improvement environments.
operational_signature: read paper → construct environment → independently reproduce baseline → review and repair evaluator → measure successive inherited attempts
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate construction, reproduction and review agents turn papers into executable research tasks.
limitations_evident: Some transcripts access held-out material; shortcut resistance and source faithfulness remain imperfect.

title: Goldsmith: Gold-Loss-Guided Definition Optimization with an Agentic Annotation Harness
problem: Annotation projects lack stable definitions and large labeled datasets.
assumption_broken: The annotation definition itself can be optimized from scarce authoritative examples.
operational_signature: run definition on gold examples → compute structured loss → diagnose high-loss cases → revise definition → accept loss reduction
load_bearing_mechanism: Gold-loss-guided textual gradients turn a small calibration set into executable supervision for definition editing.
limitations_evident: Ambiguous labels or missing private expertise cannot be repaired from insufficient gold examples.

title: SkillSandbox: Skill Verification via Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
problem: Source-task success does not show that a distilled skill is reusable.
assumption_broken: Verification tasks should be synthesized to exercise the proposed skill under novel conditions.
operational_signature: identify preserved conditions → synthesize novel executable scenario → run with and without skill → measure utility and efficiency → admit or reject
load_bearing_mechanism: Paired skill/no-skill execution in dynamically synthesized scenarios gates library admission.
limitations_evident: Synthesized environments must faithfully exercise the intended skill.

title: RSIGym: A Flexible Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Agents repeatedly rebuild research infrastructure or can modify only isolated components.
assumption_broken: Data, harness and training interventions can share a budgeted research service environment.
operational_signature: expose research services → propose system interventions → train and evaluate under budgets → select systems → compare benchmark gap closure
load_bearing_mechanism: Everything-as-a-Service provides unified permission and cost controls for joint system improvement.
limitations_evident: Reported development scores are not held-out because agents have seen the tasks.

title: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
problem: Physical robot trials are spent inefficiently when choosing code and skill revisions.
assumption_broken: The next physical experiment should distinguish competing improvement hypotheses.
operational_signature: maintain hypotheses → choose informative physical experiment → observe outcomes → co-revise code and skills → retain useful memories
load_bearing_mechanism: Value-of-information experiment selection directs code-skill co-evolution through a hypothesis graph.
limitations_evident: Robot evidence remains bounded by evaluated simulated and real-world tasks.

title: Verification and Self-Improvement in Agentic AI: Foundations and Limits
problem: Performance gains conflate additional search, support and changes to verification.
assumption_broken: Improvement claims should be separated by invariant verification frontiers and evidence obligations.
operational_signature: declare bounded verification interface → characterize native reach and closure → compare resource or code changes → audit selection error
load_bearing_mechanism: A language-based bounded-verification framework separates search success from genuine changes in accepted task frontiers.
limitations_evident: Depth separation and strict enlargement require explicit complexity assumptions.

title: The Harness as the Only Mutable Surface: Compliance-Bounded Self-Evolution of LLM Agents in Credit Pipelines, with a Measured Admission Gate
problem: Unbounded credit-agent adaptation can lower visible false positives by silently increasing missed flags.
assumption_broken: Only reviewable harness diffs should deploy through a measured admission rule.
operational_signature: diagnose regulatory errors → propose harness change → run paired retrospective and regression checks → log admission → deploy or reject
load_bearing_mechanism: A split retrospective gate with a hash-chained record blocks harmful candidate deployment.
limitations_evident: Experiments use a simulated agent and seeded-search proposer, not LLMs; fixed tolerance can block structural repair.

title: EvoSim: Learning to Model, Modeling to Learn
problem: AI scientists struggle to choose physical mechanisms and learn research procedures from modeling failures.
assumption_broken: The scientific workflow can co-evolve alongside the physical model it produces.
operational_signature: compare model with experiments → revise mechanisms and equations → test held-out conditions → distill research experience → revise scientific workflow
load_bearing_mechanism: Scientific evolution converts modeling traces into reusable knowledge, skills and orchestration changes.

improver_modified.how: Research procedures and reusable orchestration are revised from completed modeling investigations.

limitations_evident: Empirical evaluation is concentrated on two industrial battery-modeling tasks.

title: Who Verifies the Verifier? Co-Evolving Inspectable Graders with Self-Improving Agents
problem: Self-improvement loops lack trustworthy graders for open-ended outputs.
assumption_broken: The verifier can evolve, but downstream task score cannot certify its validity.
operational_signature: cluster verifier failures → synthesize detector composition → gate against trusted anchors → select agreement → use in skill evolution
load_bearing_mechanism: Inspectable detector compositions are selected by anchored agreement rather than the task agent's score.
limitations_evident: A tiny anchor limits coverage; downstream skill rollback also touches the locked test set.

title: Safe, Persistent, and Evolving Agent Harness for Understanding Partially Observable Worlds
problem: Partial observability hides side effects and organizational rules from enterprise agents.
assumption_broken: Hidden environment rules should be explicit, revisable and tested rather than presumed.
operational_signature: inspect trajectories from four views → hypothesize latent rules → perform abductive probes → verify evidence → update world ledger
load_bearing_mechanism: Environment-grounded abduction turns verified hidden rules into persistent ledger knowledge.
limitations_evident: Known-policy enforcement does not remove uncertainty about unobserved world dynamics.

title: Harness Evolution Hits a Ceiling: When Weight Training Should Begin
problem: Harness evolution eventually stops improving content-quality failures.
assumption_broken: Failure composition can determine whether to edit the harness or train the model.
operational_signature: label failure mechanisms → evolve harness → collect improved trajectories → train adapters → cross harness and weight conditions
load_bearing_mechanism: Factorial harness/weight comparisons reveal which runtime gains can be internalized and which require different interventions.
limitations_evident: Harness gains and adapter additivity differ across model sizes and task domains.

title: Memento 3: Model-Based Recursive Self-Improvement through Reflective Rulebooks
problem: Sparse observations leave multiple plausible world models for unfamiliar environments.
assumption_broken: The agent's world model can be an editable rulebook compiled into executable code.
operational_signature: observe transitions → revise rule hypotheses → compile world model → replay transitions and check faithfulness → plan with retained model
load_bearing_mechanism: Cell-exact replay and rulebook-faithfulness checks gate executable world-model revisions.
limitations_evident: Evaluation uses public ARC-AGI-3 games and a Pong case study.

title: EvoAlloc: A Self-Evolving Resource Allocation Agent for Efficient Program Evolution
problem: Fixed evaluation allocation wastes compute during program evolution.
assumption_broken: The strategy allocating search evaluation resources can improve from its own outcomes.
operational_signature: allocate evaluations → log outcomes → explore some rejected candidates → distill allocation experience → revise allocation strategy
load_bearing_mechanism: Counterfactual exploration exposes outcomes hidden by the allocator's own choices and informs strategy revision.

improver_modified.how: The search allocation strategy itself is revised from allocation experience.

limitations_evident: Efficiency conclusions depend on the program-evolution tasks and the costs counted.

title: Recursive Self-Improvement through Multi-Agent Self-Supervision
problem: A homogeneous model struggles to improve complex non-verifiable reasoning through single-instance critique.
assumption_broken: Multi-agent orchestration can provide self-supervision for the model that designs it.
operational_signature: evolve role-routing workflows → execute and self-evaluate → select trajectories → fine-tune shared model → optimize new workflows
load_bearing_mechanism: Alternating evolutionary workflow optimization with trajectory distillation improves the shared optimizer/executor model.

improver_modified.how: The same model is fine-tuned and then reused as workflow optimizer and evaluator.

limitations_evident: Self-evaluation shares model priors and the study covers two cycles.

title: Many Steps into One: Reasoning Contraction and the Limits of Safe Memory Reuse for LLM Agents
problem: Success/failure counters allow stale reasoning memories to keep answering after facts change.
assumption_broken: Memory trust should be a sequential utility certificate rather than a raw success count.
operational_signature: reuse verified memory → audit outcomes → weight failures by likelihood ratio → certify against live reasoning → restart or invalidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Likelihood-ratio change detection and live-reasoning utility certification govern safe memory reuse.
limitations_evident: The guarantees require exact verification of memory answers.

title: PhysEvo: Astra Can Act, Let It
problem: Frozen embodied models need better control and diagnostic interfaces to act reliably.
assumption_broken: Both task tools and the meta-agent's diagnostic tools can be revised from physical outcomes.
operational_signature: execute robot task → inspect physical trace → revise task or diagnostic tools → test correction → retain deployment version
load_bearing_mechanism: One frozen model improves both its action harness and the diagnostic resources used for later improvements.

improver_modified.how: Diagnostic tools in the meta-agent harness are revised for later improvement rounds.

limitations_evident: Deployment versions are task-specific and real hardware evaluation uses a small trial set.

title: EpiGuard: An Autonomous Infectious-Disease Early Warning Agent Platform
problem: Fragmented surveillance and uneven historical evidence make early warning slow and inconsistent.
assumption_broken: Successful acquisition and analysis procedures can be retained rather than recreated.
operational_signature: monitor official evidence → choose analysis regime → execute acquisition and forecasting → preserve successful SOP → reuse on new disease or region
load_bearing_mechanism: Reusable standard operating procedures retain effective data-acquisition and analytical workflows.
limitations_evident: Forecasting gains do not by themselves isolate the contribution of SOP retention.

title: Prompt Codebooks: Discrete Compositional Optimization for Language Model Instruction Refinement
problem: Monolithic global prompt edits are brittle and cannot reuse local behaviors across inputs.
assumption_broken: Prompts can be compositions of reusable instruction units with instance-specific routing.
operational_signature: encode instance → select codebook instincts → compose prompt → critique execution → attribute per-variable gradients and update
load_bearing_mechanism: A discrete instruction codebook enables localized textual credit assignment across encoder, generator and critic.
limitations_evident: Approximate additive credit assumptions constrain the theoretical account.

title: AgentOdyssey: Open-Ended Long-Horizon Text Game Generation for Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
problem: Resettable short tasks under-measure continual learning over long deployment horizons.
assumption_broken: Evaluation should interleave learning and inference in a persistent open world.
operational_signature: generate long-horizon games → interact without resetting → track knowledge and episodic recall → measure exploration and cost → diagnose limits
load_bearing_mechanism: Procedural worlds and multifaceted diagnostics expose continual-learning abilities beyond final game reward.
limitations_evident: Text games omit visual grounding and multi-agent interaction.

title: Recursive Organization Improvement: A Modeling Specification for Human--Agent Organizations
problem: Organizational improvement scores confound evidence acquisition, memory and changes to decision rules.
assumption_broken: Retained evidence and review rights must be modeled alongside the improvement procedure.
operational_signature: declare visible histories and decision rights → vary memory and rules → match evidence acquisition → compare net outcomes
load_bearing_mechanism: Acquisition-matched simulations isolate evaluator revision from the value and cost of additional evidence.

improver_modified.how: The specification allows retained revision of the organizational improvement procedure.

limitations_evident: Evidence comes from executable modeling and simulations rather than real organizational deployment.

title: TokenEconomizer: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
problem: Repeated coding tasks incur recurring environment-specific token waste.
assumption_broken: Black-box agents can be made cheaper through an experience-driven external controller.
operational_signature: inspect completed traces → synthesize micro-skills → prune irrelevant tools → intervene in loops → revise repository-specific policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Trajectory-grounded confirmation, need-rate thresholds and contradiction-triggered retirement govern persistent micro-skills alongside tool and loop controls.
limitations_evident: Stale skills, mistaken pruning and false loop detection need recovery paths.

title: MetaCurate: Evolving Curation Filters for High-Quality Agentic Coding Data
problem: Success labels do not reliably identify useful coding trajectories and training-loop filter search is expensive.
assumption_broken: Executable curation rules can be optimized from pairwise preferences before downstream training.
operational_signature: compare trajectory pairs → find ranking disagreements → revise filter rules and aggregation → retain scorer → validate by SFT
load_bearing_mechanism: Pairwise judge disagreement directs executable filter evolution without repeated model training during search.
limitations_evident: Pairwise judgments are a proxy for downstream training utility.

title: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses
problem: Research agents lack feedback connecting hypothesis development to reusable discovery procedures.
assumption_broken: Completed investigations can improve the workflow used to discover later hypotheses.
operational_signature: evolve hypothesis trees → compile investigations → attribute contribution credit → replay harness failures → apply retained improvements to new research
load_bearing_mechanism: Hypothesis-credit-weighted model training couples with replay-driven harness revisions and reuse on new investigations.

improver_modified.how: Hypothesis-credit training and harness replay change the research system used for later investigations.

limitations_evident: The paper reports partial assessment coverage and preliminary expert reviews; executing investigations to close the discovery loop remains future work.

title: DP-ES: Differentially Private Evolution Strategies for Prompt Optimization
problem: Greedy private token-level prompt construction is unstable under tight privacy budgets.
assumption_broken: Privacy should be spent on whole-prompt evaluation rather than tokenwise generation.
operational_signature: maintain full-prompt population → mutate without private data → evaluate with sampled Gaussian noise → post-process selection → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Whole-prompt evolution separates public mutation from private noisy fitness evaluation.
limitations_evident: Genuinely sensitive non-saturated deployment datasets remain future work.

title: ViSkill: Reinforcing VLM Agents with Evolving Visual-Native Skills
problem: Textual skill representations lose spatial structure and are disconnected from policy training.
assumption_broken: Reusable skills can remain visual and improve together with the VLM policy.
operational_signature: retrieve visual skill cards → execute and shape rewards → train policy → distill successful visual trajectories → update library
load_bearing_mechanism: Visual-native skill cards couple persistent skill accumulation to policy optimization.
limitations_evident: Evidence is from the evaluated puzzle and primitive-skill environments.

title: Trajectory-Guided Fault Localization for Agent Skill Evolution
problem: Skill revisions are weakly grounded in the behaviors responsible for execution failure.
assumption_broken: Revision sites should be localized from contrasted successful and failed trajectories.
operational_signature: abstract trajectories → contrast outcomes and prior edits → identify suspicious actions → localize skill sections → revise guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: Trajectory-guided fault localization links behavioral evidence to specific skill edit sites.
limitations_evident: Attribution is inferred from observed runs rather than guaranteed causal identification.

title: UniSkill: Learning Actor-Aligned Skill Proposals for an Evolving Policy
problem: Delayed reuse rewards confound skill quality with changing actor ability and new rollouts are costly.
assumption_broken: Skill proposal utility can be estimated against the current actor using already collected contrasted trajectories.
operational_signature: collect actor successes and failures → propose skillbank edit → measure action-likelihood contrast → regularize edit exploration → jointly train
load_bearing_mechanism: Actor-aligned contrastive action feedback trains skill proposals without extra per-proposal rollouts.
limitations_evident: The likelihood-gap signal is a surrogate for realized future skill utility.

title: RA-MoWE: Workflow-Affinity Embeddings for Query Clustering and Agentic Workflow Generation
problem: One global workflow ignores query heterogeneity while per-query search repeats expensive optimization.
assumption_broken: Queries can share expert workflows when their execution affinities are similar.
operational_signature: measure reference-workflow affinities → cluster queries → refine cluster workflows → train affinity encoder → route unseen queries
load_bearing_mechanism: Workflow-affinity embeddings group queries by effective reasoning strategy rather than text similarity alone.
limitations_evident: Reference-workflow evaluations are required to create the training embeddings.

title: Do Prompt Optimizers Break Requirements They Are Not Scored On? A Preregistered Study
problem: Prompt optimization may improve the target metric while violating unscored output requirements.
assumption_broken: Observed requirement regressions must be decomposed from output-budget truncation effects.
operational_signature: optimize prompts → check unscored contracts → decompose parse failures → increase output cap → compare regressions
load_bearing_mechanism: Preregistered deterministic checks and a token-cap intervention isolate contract breakage from content degradation.
limitations_evident: The larger-output-cap analysis is post hoc relative to the preregistered experiment.

title: The Winner's Curse in LLM Self-Improvement Loops: Selection Noise, Lock-in, and Acceptance Rules
problem: Noisy reused evaluation sets inflate apparent gains and lock in harmful prompt edits.
assumption_broken: A higher selection score is not an unbiased estimate of real improvement.
operational_signature: generate instruction revisions → select on small reused set → score all candidates held-out → model winner bias → compare acceptance rules
load_bearing_mechanism: Correlated-noise analysis and independent audits separate selection-set optimism from held-out gains.
limitations_evident: Tested acceptance rules do not beat greedy acceptance over complete runs.

title: How Should a Prompt Optimizer Spend a Tight Budget? BudgetAPO with Noise-Adaptive Evaluation
problem: Multi-stage prompt search wastes tight API budgets and fixed minibatches ignore task noise.
assumption_broken: Evaluation slice size should adapt to measured noise while comparisons stay paired.
operational_signature: probe task noise → allocate fixed evaluation slice → rewrite strategy and format → compare paired scores → retain candidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Noise-adaptive slice sizing and a fixed paired slice make small-budget prompt decisions more reliable.
limitations_evident: The optimizer depends on rewrite-model capability; the search budget excludes optimizer-model calls and final test evaluation.

title: RoboRSI: Stable, efficient, and reusable robot self-evolution in complex real-world environments
problem: Robot code repairs lack stable task-level responsibility and safe reusable release.
assumption_broken: A hierarchical skill library can define the scope and contract of each repair.
operational_signature: decompose skill contracts → execute → attribute outcome to branch → patch and review branch → release and consolidate compositions
load_bearing_mechanism: Top-Down Skill Refinement localizes edits and promotes stable sequences into reusable compound skills.
limitations_evident: Physical evaluation centers on one mobile manipulator and a finite household-cleanup sequence.

title: ServeLearnBench: How Well Can Agents Self-Improve from Serving Experience?
problem: Existing evaluations incompletely cover changing implicit knowledge during real service.
assumption_broken: Hidden environment policies should evolve over an ordered task stream.
operational_signature: serve tasks with hidden policies → expose outcome feedback → shift policies by window → measure adaptation and cost → diagnose exploration
load_bearing_mechanism: An evolving-environment streaming dataset measures inference, retention and revision of latent rules.
limitations_evident: Benchmark environments are controlled approximations of service deployments.

title: MESH-Harness: Self-Improving Agent Harnesses via Bandit-Guided Compositional Evolution
problem: Whole-harness search misses reusable modules and wastes limited evaluations.
assumption_broken: Alternative role-specific modules can be recombined and evaluated compositionally.
operational_signature: represent module pools → score combinations with LinUCB → search configurations → evaluate traces → edit and replenish module pools
load_bearing_mechanism: Full-covariance bandit scoring coordinates modular reuse and feedback-directed code editing.
limitations_evident: Benefits depend on a useful modular decomposition and evaluation budget.

title: Causal Improvement Graph for Agentic Harness Optimization
problem: A proposer must reconstruct evolving experimental logic from expanding raw history.
assumption_broken: Improvement state can be an explicit graph governing local proposals.
operational_signature: record evidence → connect hypotheses and interventions → evaluate outcomes → update graph → guide local harness edits
load_bearing_mechanism: Persistent Evidence-Hypothesis-Intervention-Outcome relations externalize search logic for subsequent optimization.
limitations_evident: Graph structure quality depends on the evidence and hypotheses recorded.

title: Agent Skill Evolution: How Revisions Affect Coding Agents
problem: Skill documents change like code but their behavioral effect and uptake are unclear.
assumption_broken: Skill revision, skill loading and final correctness should be measured separately.
operational_signature: mine revision pairs → isolate checkable rule edits → cross models and agents → vary skill loading → measure compliance and cost
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled first/last rule-change comparisons distinguish guidance effects from whether agents load the skill.
limitations_evident: Most revision pairs are observational and loading attenuates instruction uptake.

title: Dynamic Harness Search: Building Multi-Agent Systems Per-Query via Prediction
problem: Per-query harness search normally requires expensive executions at inference time.
assumption_broken: Execution-grounded value estimates can move search computation away from actual per-query trials.
operational_signature: collect design executions → learn architect policy and value → search harness actions with predictions → construct design → execute once
load_bearing_mechanism: A learned value function guides per-query MCTS over jointly selected structure, instructions and tools.
limitations_evident: Prediction errors can misrank unseen harness-query combinations.

title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
problem: Iteration-based program evolution ignores monetary cost and prompt-cache reuse.
assumption_broken: Search should maximize solution quality over cumulative cost rather than iterations.
operational_signature: propose strategy with strong model → implement with cheap model → execute fitness → reuse cached prefixes → retain better programs
load_bearing_mechanism: Role-separated model costs and prefix-efficient evolution improve budget-aware area under the score curve.
limitations_evident: Cost advantages depend on model pricing and caching behavior.

title: Continual Graph Memory for Mathematical Research Agents
problem: Long mathematical searches generate too many intermediate results for reliable recall and reuse.
assumption_broken: Proof-search memory should preserve dependencies, counterexamples and research-frontier structure.
operational_signature: record facts and plans in graph → retrieve local dependencies → curate evidence and frontier → recall prior failures → locally re-prove
load_bearing_mechanism: Continual Graph Memory links intermediate research artifacts with scoped evidence-sensitive retrieval.
limitations_evident: The fact-graph structure itself shows no measurable benefit in the reported ablation; published-solution access is restricted by disabling web search.

title: HASTE: Evolving Agent Harnesses Against Emerging Attacks Using Sparse Evidence
problem: New attacks arrive faster than manual harness defenses can be updated from sparse evidence.
assumption_broken: Sparse threat reports can seed an evolving adversarial test-and-repair process.
operational_signature: extract threat evidence → generate safety specifications and attacks → update harness → probe residual vulnerabilities → revise both generators
load_bearing_mechanism: Feedback couples safety-specification generation and attack-case generation to targeted harness evolution.
limitations_evident: Generated attacks may not cover all emerging real-world threats.

title: VERSE: Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses
problem: Fixed harness optimizers cannot improve their own failure diagnosis and testing procedures.
assumption_broken: The optimizer's tools and procedures can be mutable when execution verifies revisions.
operational_signature: inspect executor failures → test draft edits and perturb steps → track regressions → revise executor and optimizer resources → validate and retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Execution-based verification allows the optimizer to improve its own analysis and testing apparatus.

improver_modified.how: The optimizer revises its own prompts, skills, tools, hooks and notes.

limitations_evident: Self-evolution without verification fails to improve in the controlled study.

title: Continuous Process-Level Evaluation for Evolving Enterprise AI Agent Skills
problem: Final numeric correctness hides trajectory and database-integrity deviations in evolving enterprise skills.
assumption_broken: Process correctness needs independent evaluation beyond final answers.
operational_signature: materialize runtime tests → execute skill variants → check outcomes and process → attribute dependent failures → compare harnesses
load_bearing_mechanism: Reusable process checks localize root deviations invisible to final-state metrics.
limitations_evident: Longitudinal validation under actual API evolution remains future work.

title: VideoEvolve: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Video Temporal Grounding
problem: Manual video-grounding harness refinement must coordinate workflow and instruction changes.
assumption_broken: Stable interfaces can coexist with editable workflow code and instructions.
operational_signature: represent harness with fixed interfaces → branch candidates → diagnose grounding failures → edit instructions and code → validate and retain branches
load_bearing_mechanism: Cloze-structured harnesses and branch-guided refinement preserve interfaces while evolving the reasoning process.
limitations_evident: Instruction gains are more consistent than evolved-code gains across settings.

title: It Takes Workflows to Evolve Better Workflows
problem: A single sparse workflow reward cannot credit multiple coupled building and executing roles.
assumption_broken: More than the workflow generator can be trained using structure-aware credit.
operational_signature: construct workflow → execute roles → decompose hierarchical reward → train multiple roles → harden training tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical structure-aware rewards permit co-training several workflow roles without additional executions.
limitations_evident: Results depend on task hardening and the evaluated document, code and reasoning domains.

title: GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution
problem: GUI failures are hard to attribute because intended actions and visual effects diverge and outcomes vary.
assumption_broken: Repeated visual executions should ground bounded harness patches.
operational_signature: align screenshots with executed actions → contrast repeated runs → consolidate recurrent failures → predict patch effect → replay and validate
load_bearing_mechanism: GUI-specific action-effect alignment and repeated-run evidence support generalizable source edits.
limitations_evident: Validation requires repeated GUI execution and remains environment-dependent.

title: ActiveSaddler: Automated Curriculum Learning for Agent Harness Optimization
problem: A fixed scenario order becomes uninformative as the harness changes.
assumption_broken: The curriculum driving harness optimization should adapt to current learning progress.
operational_signature: extract recurring failure patterns → instantiate bandit arms → estimate progress → select scenarios → update patterns and priorities
load_bearing_mechanism: A non-stationary bandit dynamically constructs and prioritizes failure-pattern optimization targets.
limitations_evident: Learning-progress estimates depend on available failure evidence and rollout costs.

title: Turbo Harness: Instance-Adaptive Harness Optimization
problem: A globally optimized harness cannot match all individual task requirements.
assumption_broken: Global search artifacts can train an instance-specific harness editor.
operational_signature: collect global search artifacts → summarize playbook → train editor → patch harness for query → execute tailored harness
load_bearing_mechanism: A trained editor amortizes instance adaptation using a structured playbook from prior optimization.
limitations_evident: Instance adaptation inherits the coverage and biases of the original global search.

title: DynaHarness: A Dynamic Physical Harness for Self-Evolving Robot Agents
problem: Episode-level robot failure gives weak guidance about semantic versus physical components.
assumption_broken: A shared execution contract can expose the scope and responsibility of each capability.
operational_signature: ground bounded command → monitor execution → record contract evidence → attribute fault → patch capability and run paired regression
load_bearing_mechanism: Shared semantic-physical contracts localize capability failures and gate reusable revisions.
limitations_evident: Post-selection transfer is mainly to new initial states of the same task cells; targeted revisions are not explicitly attributed to an LLM proposer.

title: Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution
problem: Failure-reactive coding agents explore only improvements already suggested by their knowledge.
assumption_broken: New research literature can proactively expand the harness design space.
operational_signature: read new publications → organize strategies by harness module → implement alternatives → evaluate combinations → retain research-informed design
load_bearing_mechanism: Module-specific topic modeling turns external research into candidate harness strategies.
limitations_evident: Benefits depend on the retrieved literature and faithful strategy implementation.

title: EvoGen-Harness: Learning Where and How to Evolve Image-Generation Harnesses
problem: Visual generation failures do not identify which persistent harness responsibility should change.
assumption_broken: Frozen image generators need not be improved through only one predefined external component.
operational_signature: execute repeatedly → attribute failures → patch responsible components → re-attribute residuals → validate and retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Trajectory-relative attribution focuses coordinated edits while No-Patch and preservation checks suppress unnecessary changes.
limitations_evident: Stochastic image generation complicates attribution.
Evolution depends on the reliability of visual verification.

title: Scale and Selection: What Makes Automatic Harness Evolution Work for Visual-Interface Robot Agents
problem: Automatically revised robot harnesses overfit small rollout batches and degrade without promotion control.
assumption_broken: More optimizer freedom does not necessarily produce a stronger deployed harness.
operational_signature: vary rollout scale and acceptance rule → evolve harness → freeze candidate → compare disjoint robot tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled rollout-scale and Champion-Challenger comparisons separate useful harness evolution from noisy revision.
limitations_evident: Simulation only.
Rollout scaling stops at the largest affordable batch.
Real robot rollout costs limit applicability.

title: Self-Evolving Harness on Multiple Tasks with the Agent as Its Own Optimizer
problem: Separate fixed proposers and benchmark-specific harnesses limit general harness self-evolution.
assumption_broken: The same current harness can run both task solving and its own source-editing proposer.
operational_signature: solve diverse tasks → inspect full records → edit own harness → inherit source and notes → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: One frozen model on the same harness alternates between solver and proposer over multi-domain batches.

improver_modified.how: The revised harness subsequently runs both the solver and the proposer.

limitations_evident: One strong model.
No independent evolution chains.
Updates lack validation and local edits have side effects.

title: MILO: Automated Harness Discovery via Orchestrated Multi-Agent Evolution
problem: Narrow, fixed harness-search strategies become trapped during automated harness discovery.
assumption_broken: Search organization, mutation agents and curriculum can adapt along with harness candidates.
operational_signature: sample island lineage → rewrite harness → evaluate and archive → reorganize islands and mutators → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical lineage memory retains rejected evidence while an orchestrator adapts islands, mutators and curriculum.

improver_modified.how: The orchestrator revises mutator assignments, curriculum and lineage-search organization.

limitations_evident: Held-out scores also trigger search orchestration.
Long-horizon candidate evaluations are costly.

title: HARDE: Optimizing Agent Harnesses for Runtime Risk Detection and Execution Control
problem: Static runtime defenses fail to prevent diverse attacks without disrupting benign execution.
assumption_broken: Trigger, monitor and feedback execution modules can be optimized rather than manually fixed.
operational_signature: probe modules separately → derive optimization guide → revise one module → evaluate safety and utility → select
load_bearing_mechanism: Isolated probing supplies a guide for targeted risk-aware harness revisions.
limitations_evident: Evaluation uses three existing attack benchmarks.
Defense quality depends on monitor capabilities.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Skill Optimization via Cross-Harness Adaptation
problem: Skill optimization ignores public procedural knowledge and spends expensive rollouts rediscovering it.
assumption_broken: Skills from other tasks and harnesses can provide useful priors after explicit adaptation.
operational_signature: retrieve external skills → adapt to target harness → execute → retrieve failure-relevant knowledge → revise skill
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-Harness Adaptation grounds both initialization and feedback-driven updates in retrieved external skills.
limitations_evident: Requires an external skill corpus.
Domain and harness mismatches require adaptation.

title: Video-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Understanding Agents via Harness Evolution
problem: Existing video traces cannot distinguish competing explanations for missing visual evidence.
assumption_broken: A harness editor can revisit source videos instead of diagnosing only from old traces.
operational_signature: investigate original evidence → distinguish failure causes → edit harness → compare accuracy and visual cost → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Active video investigation grounds reusable code edits beyond what the incumbent happened to observe.
limitations_evident: Relies on access to original training videos.
Retention trades off accuracy and observation cost.

title: Mixture of Self-Improving Branches For Agent Harness Optimization
problem: Fixed development objectives and proposal policies channel harness evolution into one search trajectory.
assumption_broken: Branches can evolve their own objectives and proposer guidance instead of sharing one fixed search policy.
operational_signature: branch candidate lineages → update branch coverage objectives → revise proposer guidance → evaluate heads → route requests
load_bearing_mechanism: Complementary development subsets and branch-local proposal policies preserve specialized harnesses.

improver_modified.how: Branch-local proposal policies and development objectives are revised from search history.

limitations_evident: Router and heads are tuned on development data.
Observed trajectory changes do not establish causal contributions.

title: Harness Evolution as Learning: Approximation, Generalization, and Optimization Limits of Self-Improving Personal Agents
problem: The limits of personalization through frozen-model harness evolution are poorly understood.
assumption_broken: Increasing memory or harness capacity need not monotonically improve preference compliance.
operational_signature: vary architecture and memory scale → vary feedback and updates → measure compliance → explain approximation and generalization limits
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled personalization experiments are connected to reachable policies, finite-evidence capacity and biased updates.
limitations_evident: Simulated AppWorld-P preferences.
Theoretical conclusions depend on modeling assumptions.

title: SafeCoEvo: Co-Evolving Safety Harnesses and Guards for LLM Agents at Test-Time
problem: Agent safety must improve over deployment streams without repeatedly accessing a fixed training distribution.
assumption_broken: Rapid explicit safety adaptation and slower parametric guard learning should not be studied independently.
operational_signature: execute stream → externalize safety experience → update safety harness → consolidate guard parameters → evaluate future tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Dual-timescale adaptation combines an explicit S-Harness with GuardVPO parametric risk judgment.
limitations_evident: Task-performing model remains frozen but guard weights change.
Evaluation uses staged streams rather than unrestricted deployment.

title: Audit the Scaffold, Not the Checkpoint: A Stationarity Dichotomy for Recursive Self-Improvement in Agentic Coding
problem: Frozen-weight audits miss scaffold changes that expand an agent's reachable edit class.
assumption_broken: Stationarity of the reachable class, not frozen checkpoints, determines the modeled saturation regime.
operational_signature: formalize refinement → characterize reachable edits → test saturation and failure overlap → identify audit boundary
load_bearing_mechanism: A stationarity dichotomy distinguishes fixed-class search from scaffold-driven expansion.
limitations_evident: Boosting correspondence requires modeling assumptions.
Production-session shapes do not identify their cause.

title: Beyond Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Context Management Policies for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
problem: Long-horizon execution buries useful evidence in redundant or obsolete context.
assumption_broken: Context management itself can evolve instead of only accumulating experience or skill text.
operational_signature: reconstruct visible context → diagnose context failures → aggregate cases → replay counterfactuals → update context policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Context-aware trajectory reconstruction and counterfactual replay target changes to the information-management policy.
limitations_evident: Replay measures local next-action sensitivity rather than task-level causal reward.
Held-out gains vary across settings.

title: GenMem: Generative Symbolic Memory for Self-Evolving Harness
problem: Evolving memory content destabilizes retrieval addresses and yields sparse supervision for memory operations.
assumption_broken: Addresses can remain invariant while payloads evolve, and memory operations can be trained directly.
operational_signature: encode experiences into stable symbols → train read-write policies → retrieve or revise addressed payloads → measure downstream utility
load_bearing_mechanism: Stable multi-level symbolic identifiers support learned retrieval and evolution under process and contrastive outcome rewards.
limitations_evident: Depends on SID alignment and codebooks.
Training introduces separate retrieval and evolution policies.

title: MetaBench-Harness: Unlocking End-to-End Optimization of Benchmark Harnesses
problem: Static task-generation workflows constrain benchmark evolution as models saturate existing tasks.
assumption_broken: The benchmark-generation program can be optimized end to end rather than only perturbing questions.
operational_signature: generate benchmark and evaluators → assess quality → inspect evolution history → rewrite generation harness → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: An outer meta-harness searches executable benchmark-generation workflows used by the inner loop.
limitations_evident: Targets benchmark construction rather than training a solver.
Correctness depends on generated evaluator validation.

title: LiteEvo: Automated, Cost-Efficient Harness Evolution for Generalization to Unseen Tasks
problem: Harness evolution is expensive and often starts from handcrafted benchmark-specific components.
assumption_broken: Tool-free meta-agents can mine and compose reusable components from a neutral benchmark-blind seed.
operational_signature: run tasks → diagnose trajectory groups → curate versioned components → compose harness → gate on validation
load_bearing_mechanism: A versioned component library and four tool-free meta-agent roles amortize harness construction.
limitations_evident: One evolution run per benchmark.
Main transductive setting evolves on graded tasks.
Cost accounting omits local worker GPUs.

title: Compositional Safety Failures in Harness Evolution: Identification and Runtime Monitoring
problem: Individually safe harness-component updates can interact to create unsafe persistent behavior.
assumption_broken: Component-wise safety validation does not establish safety of the composed harness.
operational_signature: validate single updates → compose pairs and triples → trace unsafe interactions → maintain local interaction hypergraph → monitor runtime
load_bearing_mechanism: A typed incremental hypergraph focuses checking on activated higher-order component interactions.
limitations_evident: Interaction checking remains a safety-utility-cost trade-off.
Study focuses on identified pairwise and three-way failures.

title: ExpVoyager: Direct Experience Navigation for Dynamic Agent Skill Synthesis
problem: Precompiled skills discard experience needed by future tasks while retaining irrelevant details.
assumption_broken: Skill extraction can occur on demand through direct navigation of raw experience.
operational_signature: identify current knowledge needs → navigate experience views → extract procedures → track remaining gaps → synthesize task skill
load_bearing_mechanism: A curator actively selects views and resolutions of raw trajectories according to current unmet needs.
limitations_evident: Needs a usable raw experience archive.
Skill synthesis is conditioned on downstream demand.

title: PluginRSI: Recursive Improvement of Agent Harnesses with Reusable Plugins
problem: Whole-program harness evolution makes individual mechanisms hard to isolate and reuse.
assumption_broken: Harness mechanisms can evolve independently as atomized plugins and later be recombined.
operational_signature: mutate individual plugins → evaluate → accumulate library → recompose harness → transfer reusable mechanisms
load_bearing_mechanism: Separating plugin mutation from harness recomposition accumulates reusable mechanisms across searches.
limitations_evident: Requires a plugin-parameterized harness.
Mechanism interactions still require harness evaluation.

title: Mara Chain: Rethinking Failure as a Stepping Stone for AI System Auto-Evolution
problem: Discarding rejected artifact candidates repeatedly destroys information needed to cross search barriers.
assumption_broken: A failed candidate can be a useful stepping stone rather than a terminal dead end.
operational_signature: propose candidate → evaluate failure → refine rejected candidate using history → bound chain depth → Pareto-filter pool
load_bearing_mechanism: Bounded history-conditioned refinement preserves rejected paths while Pareto Top-N selection bounds the pool.
limitations_evident: Batch-local diagnosis can overfit.
Context construction and diagnosis are hand-designed.

title: Automatic Harness Evolution for Hardware Design Verification: Can LLMs Consolidate Gains Across Discovered Harnesses?
problem: Hardware harness evolution may produce complementary task gains without consolidating reliable diagnosis.
assumption_broken: More completed attempts and higher any-hit coverage need not imply durable diagnostic improvement.
operational_signature: evolve isolated candidates → repeat task trials → replay validation selections → compare consolidation and regressions
load_bearing_mechanism: Repeated trials and subsequent replay reveal that selected gains fail to consolidate across tasks.
limitations_evident: Only twelve proprietary root-cause tasks.
Replay mixes search and validation tasks.
Cross-benchmark experiments are not matched.

title: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic Skill Discovery
problem: Robot skill changes pass local tests without accumulating into end-to-end task success.
assumption_broken: Accepted self-improvement changes measure activity rather than necessarily measuring progress.
operational_signature: observe robot failures → write or install skills → test in simulation → retain → trace persistent failure over rounds
load_bearing_mechanism: A long-run diagnostic record exposes evaluator errors, misleading memory and early-chain feedback lock-in.
limitations_evident: One long run on one simulator and layout.
No independent replicates or matched-budget baselines.
Harness repairs and providers changed over time.

title: Harness as a Language: A Minimalist Agent Framework With Maximal Expressivity
problem: Specialized harnesses hard-code memory and self-improvement outside the basic agent loop.
assumption_broken: A minimal recursive code loop with model-visible state as variables can express specialized workflows itself.
operational_signature: expose inputs and history as variables → generate executable code → recursively invoke agents → carry state across workflow
load_bearing_mechanism: The invoke primitive combines recursive code generation with direct programmatic access to all visible context.
limitations_evident: Main contribution is a general expressive runtime.
Specialized behaviors are elicited by prompting.

title: Assembling Insights for Agentic Machine Learning Engineering Systems
problem: MLE agents collect and inject prior-task insights ad hoc, risking target-task leakage.
assumption_broken: External competition solutions can supply complementary domain, competition and improvement skills under controlled sourcing.
operational_signature: separate source and target competitions → inspect expert solutions → assemble typed insights → inject skills or playbooks → test
load_bearing_mechanism: Leakage-controlled insight assembly separates knowledge source/type from injection mode.
limitations_evident: Kaggle predictive tasks are not all production MLE.
Only one insight-assembly backend is tested.
Assembly and evaluation are costly.

title: Safety Must Survive Self-Improvement: Why Failures Persist and How Agents Recover
problem: Unsafe executable variants can persist after contracts change or all proposed repairs are rejected.
assumption_broken: Validation success, deployment choice and the next editing source are separate safety decisions.
operational_signature: evolve stateful components → change authorization contract → pair deployment and edit-source interventions → trace persistence and recovery
load_bearing_mechanism: Paired histories isolate stale archive scores, failed-incumbent persistence and repair-source effects.
limitations_evident: Controlled stateful authorization testbed.
Refreshed original-suite correctness does not remove all independently composed-test failures.

title: MERID: Multimodal Exploration via Recursive Self-Improvement Agents for Major Depression Analysis
problem: Small heterogeneous depression cohorts make autonomous multimodal pipeline inheritance unreliable.
assumption_broken: Pipeline revision must be authorized against uncertainty rather than inheriting every higher development score.
operational_signature: ground multimodal records → jointly revise pipeline → evaluate uncertainty → keep verified successor → reuse experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Evidence-Guided Evolution verifies gains under uncertainty before inheriting pipeline changes.
limitations_evident: Small depression cohorts.
Pipeline validity depends on subject-level separation and evaluation quality.

title: RSI-Router: Evolving Subtask-Level LLM Routing and Skills for Cost-Efficient Agents
problem: Long-horizon agents overpay for large-model steps that smaller models could handle with suitable skills.
assumption_broken: Model routing should evolve jointly with reusable model-specific procedural guidance.
operational_signature: mine subtasks → propose model assignments → contrast execution failures → evolve model-specific skills → retain cost-performance frontier
load_bearing_mechanism: Pareto router selection couples model assignment with skills derived from large-versus-small trajectory contrasts.
limitations_evident: Routing depends on the chosen model pair.
Requires repeated routed trajectory evaluation.

title: COEVO: Co-Evolving Context and Parameters for Recursive Self-Improvement
problem: Fixed context ignores changing model behavior during on-policy learning.
assumption_broken: The learning context should adapt together with policy parameters rather than remain a static interface.
operational_signature: roll out under context → update parameters → inspect entropy and attention → propose context revision → selectively retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Policy entropy and prompt-conditioned attention jointly steer contextual adaptation during RL.
limitations_evident: Full RL comparisons are computationally limited.
Experiments focus on math and code.

title: Sivia: Learning to Draw, Learning to Learn
problem: Overview figures omit scientific relations and fixed skill updaters do not reliably correct them.
assumption_broken: The instruction updater itself can be revised using downstream drawing-skill improvements.
operational_signature: derive source relations → draw figure → obtain human feedback → revise drawing skill → compare and revise updater
load_bearing_mechanism: Two-level human-guided learning revises both drawing instructions and the updater that proposes their edits.

improver_modified.how: A learned updater replaces the fixed updater and produces later drawing-skill revisions.

limitations_evident: Single learning history.
Authors' group supplies ratings and admission decisions.
GEPA baseline omits Pareto maintenance and merging.

title: Which Self-Improvements Should We Trust? Reliable Self-Improvement When Agents Reuse Their Benchmarks
problem: Adaptive benchmark reuse makes empirical promotions unreliable despite ordinary multiple-comparison corrections.
assumption_broken: A fixed finite evaluation set can support adaptive search only if feedback leakage and decision histories are accounted for.
operational_signature: propose modification → compute restricted comparison → allocate history-aware error budget → return promotion bit → continue

Safety and cost are not jointly controlled.

title: MedRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Medical Agents via Clinically Aligned Self-Evolution
problem: Medical agents need new capabilities without allowing exploratory clinical tools to enter deployment prematurely.
assumption_broken: Capability invention and persistent clinical registration should operate at different rates.
operational_signature: diagnose patient cohort → prioritize clinical failures → compose or train capability → trial on subsequent cohorts → register sustained benefit
load_bearing_mechanism: Fast discovery with slow registration admits new tools only after sustained cohort-level benefit.
limitations_evident: Includes private clinical tasks.
Requires independent cohorts and reliable reference diagnoses.
Prospective clinical evaluation remains necessary.

title: From Experience to Expertise: Adoption-Aware Memory Learning for Data-Scarce NPU Kernel Synthesis
problem: Uniform memory credit and repeated retrieval prevent efficient accumulation of NPU programming expertise.
assumption_broken: Memory utility should depend on actual adoption rather than giving all retrieved items equal credit.

load_bearing_mechanism: Adoption-Traced Utility assigns item-level credit and Utility-Gated Consolidation promotes recurring useful knowledge.
limitations_evident: Thirty-round study does not cover fused kernels and megakernels.
Utility depends on tracing adoption correctly.

title: When Better Gets Worse: Improvement Fidelity for Self-Improving Agents in Adaptive Worlds
problem: Proxy-ranked policy improvements may worsen deployment outcomes in worlds changed by the policy itself.
assumption_broken: High global verifier accuracy does not guarantee correct local replacement decisions.
operational_signature: propose update → estimate decision uncertainty → allocate paired high-fidelity tests → compare deployment effect → select
load_bearing_mechanism: PIVOT-KG allocates scarce high-fidelity evaluation by expected selection-regret reduction per unit cost.
limitations_evident: Confidence intervals condition on fitted calibration models.
Stress tests use finite scheduled candidate sets.

title: GameBoyWorlds: A Testbed for Self-Improvement in Embodied Video Games
problem: Agent execution scores do not reveal whether autonomous game experience yields transferable grounded knowledge.
assumption_broken: Success in familiar official games does not establish learning in unseen game worlds.
operational_signature: explore training games → build knowledge or skills → freeze or carry learned state → evaluate unseen tasks and playthroughs
load_bearing_mechanism: Dedicated training games and unfamiliar game variants test knowledge acquisition separately from prior model exposure.
limitations_evident: Existing autonomous skill discovery and world modeling largely fail.
Playthrough baselines do not reach the first major milestone.

title: Memory as Middleware for Self-Improving AI Agents
problem: Bespoke memory binds agents to individual storage engines and fragments governance across hosts.
assumption_broken: Memory can be a pluggable middleware layer independent of both agent host and storage backend.
operational_signature: collect trajectories → extract guidelines → persist with governed interfaces → retrieve through host-native hooks → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Two-sided pluggability and host-native interposition separate memory learning and governance from agent implementations.
limitations_evident: Reference implementation covers an initial subset of the proposed design.
Evaluation is feasibility evidence rather than a complete systems study.

title: EASE: Behavior-Adaptive Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Learned skill curators degrade when transferred to executors with different behavior.
assumption_broken: One curator can adapt to multiple executors if curation is conditioned on an online behavioral profile.
operational_signature: profile recent execution → edit retrieved skills → observe later usage → attribute downstream utility → train shared curator
load_bearing_mechanism: Behavior-conditioned curation and retrieval-aware temporal credit learn executor-dependent skill editing.
limitations_evident: Curator training uses a finite executor set.
Temporal attribution relies on observable downstream influence.

title: SAGE: A Statistical Acceptance Gate for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Aggregate validation improvements hide regressions and optimizer's-curse selection noise.
assumption_broken: A higher mean score is not enough evidence to replace a persistent skill.
operational_signature: propose skill edit → compare identical items → penalize regressions → test paired wins against losses → commit or abstain
load_bearing_mechanism: Asymmetric per-item comparison plus a one-sided paired test filters unreliable updates.
limitations_evident: Current gate assumes binary rewards.
Gate hyperparameters require tuning.

title: The Right Lesson at the Right Step: Deriving Control Updates for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Global lessons cannot reliably affect the correct decision in long tool-use workflows.
assumption_broken: Experience should specify where and when it changes control flow rather than only what text to remember.
operational_signature: inspect residual goals and traces → locate control node → propose scoped edit → compare matched-checkpoint continuations → compile and confirm
load_bearing_mechanism: Paired continuations from the same checkpoint test localized control-program edits before inheritance.
limitations_evident: Programs are frozen after training in the current evaluation.
Online accumulation over open-ended streams is not evaluated.

title: EverMine: Dissecting the Self-Evolution of Research Capabilities in Long-Horizon Alpha Research
problem: Accumulated research capabilities may not causally improve later portfolio-conditioned alpha discovery.
assumption_broken: End-to-end research gains do not establish value of explicit capability evolution.
operational_signature: run fixed and evolving capability conditions → hold history and portfolio fixed → replace capability state → replay decisions → compare outcomes
load_bearing_mechanism: Matched continuation branches isolate the conditional value of accumulated capabilities.
limitations_evident: Capability replacement does not isolate individual skills, tools and documents.
Pretraining temporal contamination cannot be excluded.
Replay covers two batches from one trajectory.

title: Beyond Endpoint Performance: Process-Level Evaluation of Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Endpoint scores hide when learned capabilities emerge, disappear or fail to adapt.
assumption_broken: Persistent self-evolution must be measured along its trajectory rather than only at the last artifact.
operational_signature: present ordered episodes → freeze artifact checkpoints → evaluate held-out capabilities → measure transfer, retention and adaptation
load_bearing_mechanism: Read-only checkpoint evaluation separates generalization, forgetting and rule adaptation over streams.
limitations_evident: Hybrid market environment with calibrated synthetic trajectories.
Selection safeguards do not reliably predict held-out gains.

title: Self-Evolving Coding Rules for AI Coding Agents
problem: Handcrafted coding-rule documents are labor-intensive and may harm correctness or generation efficiency.
assumption_broken: Long coding-rule files can be evolved as a population rather than treated as immutable instructions.
operational_signature: sample rule candidates → mutate documents → evaluate generated programs → allocate mutation effort → prune to best pool
load_bearing_mechanism: Strategic mutation allocation and pruning evolve a fixed-size pool of coding rules.
limitations_evident: Rules are selected on sampled coding tasks.
Correctness, code length and cost objectives can differ.

title: MemCodex: Self-Programming Hierarchical Memory for Language Agents
problem: Predefined memory workflows cannot satisfy heterogeneous evidence needs across queries.
assumption_broken: Memory construction, indexing, retrieval and routing code can be searched beyond a fixed design space.
operational_signature: represent layered memory as programs → rewrite attributed methods → evaluate and accept → route reads coarse to fine
load_bearing_mechanism: Open-ended per-method program evolution changes memory implementations behind a stable five-method interface.
limitations_evident: Fixed runtime and layer interface constrain evolution.
Question splits are not necessarily record-disjoint deployment.

title: Do Self-Evolving Skills Generalize to Held-Out Tasks?
problem: Training gains from repeatedly rewritten skills often fail to transfer to unseen tasks.
assumption_broken: Learning one increasingly specific task skill need not generalize as well as learning a guide that generates skills.
operational_signature: standardize agent and splits → evolve competing skills → compare train-test retention → inspect artifacts → optimize skill-writing guide
load_bearing_mechanism: Matched comparisons expose over-specific skill edits and motivate per-task skill generation from a retained metaskill.

improver_modified.how: GSO changes the retained guide that writes a fresh task-specific skill rather than retaining one universal task skill.
