limitations_evident: Content judges predict whole-skill quality better than single-edit effects.
Edits still require executable validation.

title: Breaking Babel: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Long-Form Subtitle Translation
problem: Static translation workflows cannot maintain long-series consistency while adapting to scene complexity.
assumption_broken: Routing policies and agent prompts can adapt on early series content and persist for later content.
operational_signature: translate adaptation subset → judge candidates → refine prompts and routing → update series memory → freeze and translate remainder
load_bearing_mechanism: A judge-refiner loop adapts a routed multi-agent translation configuration without retraining LLMs.
limitations_evident: Adaptation is series-specific.
Evaluation includes heterogeneous community subtitle references.

title: Topological Coherence for Self-evolving Multi-agent Systems
problem: Separately optimized responsibilities, handoffs and memory boundaries become inconsistent with task dependencies.
assumption_broken: A team's agent, collaboration and memory structures should evolve coherently from a shared task topology.
operational_signature: ground task graph → allocate responsibilities → derive handoffs and memory visibility → propose coupled changes → validate structure and reward
load_bearing_mechanism: Topological coherence constrains jointly evolved agent, collaboration and memory policies.
limitations_evident: Structural validity depends on grounded task and tool representations.
Evaluation uses finite benchmark task families.

title: AnyAct: Universal Action for Self-Evolving Agents
problem: Large dynamic tool ecosystems exceed context limits and contain changing tool reliability.
assumption_broken: Available action rankings should adapt to execution history rather than rely only on static descriptions.
operational_signature: retrieve action hierarchy → execute selected tool → record failures and successes → update reliability → suppress unreliable actions
load_bearing_mechanism: Test-time reliability evolution modifies action ranking using execution success and consecutive failures.
limitations_evident: Tool reliability estimates need sufficient history.
Tool-documentation changes require refresh while preserving execution history.

title: Self-Evolving Multimedia Verification through Memory Consolidation of Contestation Experiences
problem: Multimedia verification needs correctable provenance and protection against harmful memory reuse.
assumption_broken: Experience should enter active memory only after verification while unresolved conflicts remain explicit.
operational_signature: collect evidence → build provenance arguments → accept scoped correction → verify reusable experience → consolidate or retain conflict
load_bearing_mechanism: Verification-gated consolidation prevents unsafe transfer and preserves contested knowledge separately.
limitations_evident: Full COSMOS evaluations are single-run.
Three-seed stability uses only a subset.
Contestation and challenge sets contain few independent cases.

title: Fusion is the New Mutation: Bandit-Guided Evolution on Workflow Graphs
problem: Costly workflow evaluation makes unguided parent-combination search inefficient.
assumption_broken: Which workflows to fuse can be learned from offspring feedback rather than selected randomly.
operational_signature: embed parent combinations → select bandit arm → fuse workflow code → evaluate child → update bandit and lineage DAG
load_bearing_mechanism: A diagonal LinUCB policy generalizes fusion rewards across embedded multi-parent combinations.
limitations_evident: Linear bandit uncertainty is only an exploration proxy.
Workflow evaluation remains expensive.

title: Prompt2Skill: Unsupervised Skill Optimization From Natural Language Instructions
problem: Automated skills normally require a curated target-task training set that may not exist.
assumption_broken: Natural-language task descriptions can seed both proxy data creation and reflective skill optimization.
operational_signature: derive task specification → retrieve or synthesize proxy data → execute skill → reflect and edit → statistically screen fresh batches
load_bearing_mechanism: Coupled data and skill agents optimize reusable instructions from task descriptions alone.
limitations_evident: Proxy-data suitability and evaluator quality limit optimization.
The method does not start from supplied target-task training examples.

title: Streamlined Reflective Evolution for Task-Adaptive Self-Refinement Pipelines
problem: Fixed self-refinement structures accumulate redundant instructions and restrict useful stage specialization.
assumption_broken: Both prompt contents and the number and responsibilities of sequential refinement stages can be learned.
operational_signature: reflect on examples → revise prompts → split overloaded stage → screen locally → Pareto-admit and roll back → freeze pipeline
load_bearing_mechanism: SPLIT redistributes instructions across specialized stages during reflective structure search.
limitations_evident: Call counts do not measure token or latency cost.
Matched token and latency evaluation remains future work.

title: ClusterFewshot: Improving Few-shot Optimization for LLMs workflow
problem: Random or metric-ranked few-shot selection ignores semantic task coverage and repeats bootstrapping cost.
assumption_broken: Successful demonstrations should be selected using semantic structure as well as empirical utility.
operational_signature: bootstrap successful traces once → embed and cluster examples → compare sampling strategies → retain demonstration set
load_bearing_mechanism: Semantic clustering and utility-aware scoring construct representative few-shot sets with one-shot evaluation.
limitations_evident: Off-the-shelf embeddings may miss task semantics.
Small held-out selection subsets may be unrepresentative.

title: TeleTune: Evolving Agent Skills From Offline Telemetry
problem: Offline user telemetry lacks explicit goals, replayability and clear task boundaries for skill learning.
assumption_broken: A reusable skill library can be optimized against logged next actions without replaying live episodes.
operational_signature: infer goals from logs → predict actions → diagnose prediction errors → edit library → gate on held-out logged actions
load_bearing_mechanism: Skill-guided progress supplies a cheap offline proxy for selecting procedural-library edits.
limitations_evident: Action-prediction progress is a proxy for live task success.
Telemetry may interleave tasks and omit intent.

title: SkillVine: Agent Skill Evolution via Branching Exploration
problem: Linear skill-library evolution discards promising alternative paths and becomes stuck in local optima.
assumption_broken: Historical library versions can be complementary parents rather than obsolete checkpoints.
operational_signature: update trunk on current batch → select complementary historical nodes → branch library updates → gate edit granularity → retain version graph
load_bearing_mechanism: Trunk-branch collaboration and complementarity-aware parent selection preserve alternative skill trajectories.
limitations_evident: Search is bounded by agent rollout budget.
Branch libraries may see only subsets of the training stream.

title: What Does a Harness Repair? A Preregistered Study of Visibility, Baseline Adequacy and Evaluation Defects
problem: Harness-search gains can reflect parser visibility, weak baselines or evaluator defects rather than better answers.
assumption_broken: Replication through the same pipeline need not uncover an evaluation defect.
operational_signature: preregister endpoints → vary inference and parser settings → inject isolated defects → search prompts → compare replication and test partitions
load_bearing_mechanism: All-endpoint preregistered comparisons separate answer visibility, baseline adequacy and evaluation distortion.
limitations_evident: One GPU serving environment.
Intervals cover item sampling, not prompt or judge variance.
Earlier model calls limit prospective claims.

title: SEDIMA: Cross-Run Hierarchical Insight Memory for Evolutionary Search Agents
problem: Evolutionary search restarts without retaining why previous mutations succeeded or failed.
assumption_broken: Search knowledge can transfer across runs and problems without changing search operators.
operational_signature: evaluate mutation → distill insight → cluster persistent guidance → retrieve relevant lessons → condition next mutation
load_bearing_mechanism: Hierarchical insight memory preserves trace-linked natural-language knowledge across independent searches.
limitations_evident: Main model-harness cells are single-run.
No direct comparison to other memory-based evolutionary systems.
Summaries and retrieval can propagate misleading guidance.

title: EvoDuet: Bilevel Co-Evolution of Web Searching and Task Solving for Scientific Discovery
problem: Evolutionary discovery stalls when external knowledge retrieval does not adapt to changing candidate solutions.
assumption_broken: Web queries and document use should evolve jointly with solution search rather than remain fixed tooling.
operational_signature: assess knowledge gap → retrieve or reuse documents → refine queries → propose solution candidates → evaluate and record outcomes
load_bearing_mechanism: A bilevel query-solution loop uses predicted document utility and recorded evaluations to guide later retrieval.
limitations_evident: Small Qwen model does not benefit.
Predicted document gains can produce worse evaluated candidates.
Additional retrieval introduces cost.

title: Adaptive-GEPA: Make Your Harness Fit Heterogeneous Requests
problem: A shared program or predefined task-specific dispatcher fixes the division of heterogeneous requests too early.
assumption_broken: The router, specialist responsibility descriptions and specialist programs can be optimized together.
operational_signature: execute mixed requests → diagnose routing and program behavior → edit specialists and router → align branches by allocation → select
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint request allocation and specialist program evolution learns an unlabeled division of work.
limitations_evident: Final method has one seed on four task families.
Nominal scored-call budgets do not equate compute.
Development-time test monitoring is disclosed.

title: Vestrum: Improving Agent Harnesses by Adapting Their Verification, Structure and Memory
problem: Long-environment evaluations make feedback-driven harness improvement costly.
assumption_broken: Recurring failures within related tasks may admit scoped transferable harness remedies.
operational_signature: classify trace failures → propose scoped changes → screen scope → evaluate bundle → persist lessons
load_bearing_mechanism: Recognizable failure classes focus changes to verification, retrieval, decomposition and knowledge synthesis.
limitations_evident: Only abstract available; all evidence fields remain unclear.

title: SkillEvoLean: Mutation-enhanced skill evolution for Lean provers
problem: All-failed Lean proof trajectories provide no successful pattern for incremental skill refinement.
assumption_broken: Reference concepts and proof techniques can be mutated alongside the root solving policy.
operational_signature: sample proof trajectories → refine from successes and failures → trigger concept-guided mutation on stagnation → verify candidates → retain gain
load_bearing_mechanism: Concept-guided mutations escape all-failure states while progressive edits exploit informative proof traces.
limitations_evident: Aggregate acceptance can still lose individual solved problems.
Skill quality depends on training diversity and verifier feedback.

title: Rep2Skill: Representation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
problem: Text-only skill revision misses internal execution signals that localize unsuccessful reasoning turns.
assumption_broken: Internal model representations can guide external textual skill updates without updating the executor weights.
operational_signature: collect rollout representations → localize deviations from successful dynamics → verbalize attribution → revise skill → accept validation improvement
load_bearing_mechanism: Representation-trajectory attribution supplies targeted textual feedback beyond sparse outcomes and long traces.
limitations_evident: Requires white-box representation access.
Evaluated mainly on Qwen models.
Adds about fifty rollouts and lightweight representation training.

title: From Solo to Social Learning: Characterizing Recursive Social Improvement in LLMs
problem: Peer copying may reduce private search yet fail to improve a self-interested agent population at equal cost.
assumption_broken: Social transmission of skills does not necessarily outperform independent discovery.
operational_signature: allocate shared token budget → search or observe peers → copy and revise skill files → act for individual reward → compare solo populations
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled social-versus-solo comparisons distinguish cheaper learning from more effective discoveries.
limitations_evident: Agents use one model within each population.
Peer list order is fixed.
Comparisons match realized spend rather than prespecified budget.

title: Semantic Projection for Continual Self-Evolution of Language Agents
problem: A shared evolving skill forgets earlier procedures when new heterogeneous tasks demand conflicting changes.
assumption_broken: Historical regressions can constrain a constructive revision instead of only vetoing new updates.
operational_signature: propose skill revision → identify threatened capabilities → audit historical behavior → construct compatible semantic edit → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Behavior-space projection uses observed gains and regressions to repair interfering skill revisions.
limitations_evident: Finite domains arrive in grouped streams.
Historical verification banks bound what interference can be detected.

title: Certified Long-Horizon Code Agent Evolution via Validation-Gated Skill Optimization
problem: Unrestricted accumulation of extracted skills causes long-horizon regressions in code agents.
assumption_broken: A plausible skill addition need not be retained merely because it fixes an observed task.
operational_signature: Execute tasks → extract skill updates → compare candidate bank on validation → accept with a margin → retrieve for later tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: A positive-margin validation gate controls bank replacement, while a disjoint final set measures gain and drawdown.
limitations_evident: Promotion reuses a fixed validation panel.
Certificates require stated sampling and variance assumptions.

title: A Wrong Turn Does Not Ruin the Journey: Deviation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
problem: Whole-trajectory reflection obscures the first actionable mistake and produces destructive skill rewrites.
assumption_broken: A failed trajectory can contain a valuable prefix that should be preserved rather than discarded.
operational_signature: Locate deviation → continue the preserved prefix with a teacher → contrast suffixes → write conditional skill deltas → regression-check
load_bearing_mechanism: Successful teacher continuations from the same prefix isolate minimal corrections at the deviation point.
limitations_evident: Correction depends on stronger-teacher continuations.

title: TTSE: A Two-Track Online Self-Evolution Framework
problem: Mixing environmental facts with procedural advice makes online agent experience difficult to maintain and reuse.
assumption_broken: One undifferentiated procedural memory is not the only useful representation of experience.
operational_signature: Observe interaction → separately induce facts and tips → reconcile and track evidence → retrieve the appropriate track
load_bearing_mechanism: Independent FACT and TIP stores separate declarative environment knowledge from conditional procedures.
limitations_evident: Lifecycle behavior depends on the host integration.

title: Grow the Harness, Not the Context: From Strategy-Free Scaffolds to Reusable Specialist Agents
problem: Longer contexts do not reliably convert repeated failures into reusable specialist behavior.
assumption_broken: A strategy-free executable scaffold can acquire control structure instead of accumulating instructions alone.
operational_signature: Collect failures → localize responsible functions → jointly patch a failure window → evaluate gate tasks → retain or roll back
load_bearing_mechanism: Failure-window code repairs are accepted by a success-first held-out gate protecting prior capability.
limitations_evident: Only two benchmark environments are evaluated.
Reusable code cannot replace all semantic model judgments.

title: Towards Strategy-Level RSI for Skill-Augmented Agents: Learning When to Reuse Skills from Execution Feedback
problem: Always loading an available skill wastes context and can reduce success when the skill is conditionally unhelpful.
assumption_broken: Skill reuse decisions can improve while the skills, backbone, and harness remain fixed.
operational_signature: Run paired with/without-skill trials → estimate conditional utility → update evidence → load a skill or abstain
load_bearing_mechanism: Paired execution outcomes estimate marginal skill value for a state rather than judging skill text.
limitations_evident: Study uses 20 fixed skills and 160 held-out states.
Final success matches the strong zero-shot controller rather than exceeding it.

title: ChipMEM: Verification-Grounded Memory for EDA Agents
problem: EDA agents reuse unverified procedural memories and fail to distinguish dependable procedures from unreliable ones.
assumption_broken: Procedural memory should be grounded in tool verification and measured execution history rather than narrative plausibility.
operational_signature: Solve design tasks → verify traces → package procedures → update hierarchical success statistics → admit and retrieve skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Simulation, synthesis, and formal checks ground memory admission, with Bayesian success and recovery statistics supporting reuse.
limitations_evident: Held-out CVDP evaluation contains 20 tasks and one evaluation per setting.
Retrieval uses a fixed top-two policy.

title: TimeEvo: Failure-Driven Self-Evolution of a Time Series Agent
problem: A time-series agent repeatedly encounters capability gaps that a fixed tool library cannot cover.
assumption_broken: The tool set can be synthesized from recurring failures rather than fully specified in advance.
operational_signature: Cluster failures → synthesize tools for gaps → test attributable repairs → run paired library gate → install retained tools
load_bearing_mechanism: Failure buckets ground tool synthesis, and a separate library-level admission test checks net downstream utility.
limitations_evident: Experiments begin with an empty library and use one evolution round.
Per-tool validation samples at most 32 bucket errors.

title: Self-Evolving Time-Series Forecasting Agents with Episodic Memory and Online Policy Learning
problem: Forecasting agents do not reliably convert delayed forecast errors into decisions for subsequent series.
assumption_broken: Completed forecasting instances can become reusable episodic evidence and evolving policy guidance.
operational_signature: Forecast → observe delayed truth → store episode and update guidance → retrieve similar cases → choose the next forecast
load_bearing_mechanism: Feature-matched episodic retrieval is combined with online policy summaries and ranking guidance.
limitations_evident: Evaluation covers 29 selected GIFT-Eval configurations.
Delayed feedback constrains when experience becomes available.

title: RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents
problem: Embodied failures recur because frozen-model agents do not improve the supporting system across tasks.
assumption_broken: The surrounding filesystem, tools, and skill hierarchy can serve as an editable policy.
operational_signature: Execute → diagnose system failure → repair the task harness → generalize the edit → test capability-matched traces → commit
load_bearing_mechanism: Task-specific repairs are promoted to general system edits using capability-conditioned held-out traces.
limitations_evident: Online stream scores include evolution rather than only frozen final evaluation.
Generalization depends on capability-matched traces.

title: The Epistemics of Agent Memory: Measuring, and Governing, the Consolidation Decision in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
problem: End-to-end agent scores obscure whether memory consolidation decisions are correct, transferable, or reversible.
assumption_broken: A consolidation quality score cannot simply be assumed to predict downstream transfer.
operational_signature: Isolate consolidation decisions → compare with an oracle → test downstream transfer → audit and reverse harmful consolidation
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled consolidation benchmarks separate decision quality, external transfer, and governance effects.
limitations_evident: Consolidation quality did not predict external transfer.
Benchmark is synthetic-first.
Governance is demonstrated on one policy.

title: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence
problem: A single monolithic harness cannot exploit complementary specialist agent systems.
assumption_broken: Whole model-harness pairs can be composable units rather than interchangeable model calls.
operational_signature: Describe specialist contracts → compose a host-mediated execution graph → execute and evaluate → retain reusable procedures
load_bearing_mechanism: Host-mediated composition connects specialist harnesses through explicit artifact and resource obligations.
limitations_evident: Condensed source omits some implementation and optimization details.
Complementarity must be measured rather than inferred from individual specialist scores.

title: Remember by Asking: Retrieval-Induced Memory Evolution for LLM Agents
problem: Dialogue memory can omit useful facts during formation and fail again when answering later questions.
assumption_broken: Retrieval from the original dialogue can improve both memory creation and memory use.
operational_signature: Ask generic self-questions → retrieve source dialogue → reconcile historical memory → answer with selective source fallback
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-question-induced retrieval exposes missing source evidence before memory reconciliation.
limitations_evident: Evaluation uses one dialogue-memory benchmark.
The same model family supplies answers and judgments.

title: Remember Before You're Asked: MemDream for Self-Probing Memory Evolution
problem: Reactive memory repair discovers weaknesses only after a real user question has already failed.
assumption_broken: An agent can proactively probe and repair memory between interactions.
operational_signature: Dream queries → diagnose retrieval weaknesses → consolidate or decay memory → measure downstream reward → train repair agents
load_bearing_mechanism: GRPO trains Dreamer, Analyst, and Consolidator policies while reversible decay limits destructive forgetting.
limitations_evident: Rule-based probes remain stronger on some diagnostic measures.
Reward weights and retrieval depth influence repair behavior.

title: From Weak Task Specifications to Scientific Extraction Agents: Optimizing Task Construction
problem: Weak scientific extraction specifications leave both schema construction and extraction prompts underspecified.
assumption_broken: Task construction and its optimization rubric can evolve instead of being fixed before prompt tuning.
operational_signature: Construct schema and prompts → extract records → diagnose stage errors → propagate textual edits and update rubrics → select checkpoints
load_bearing_mechanism: Failure-focused stage optimization couples task artifacts with evolving training criteria while fixed expert rubrics remain reserved for reporting.
limitations_evident: Each optimization stage uses few update and selection documents.
Training rubrics differ from the fixed reporting rubrics.

title: FlowMAS: Learning Multi-Agent Workflow Topology via Information-guided Generative Flow Network
problem: Workflow search is expensive and generic generators poorly represent discrete multi-agent dependencies.
assumption_broken: Workflow topology generation can be learned as a reward-guided distribution over structured graphs.
operational_signature: Generate workflow → execute → assign information-aware reward → train flow policy with novelty → sample new workflows
load_bearing_mechanism: A GFlowNet learns topology distributions using curiosity and information-guided credit assignment.
limitations_evident: Workflow quality depends on the generator and reward design.

title: Explore, Execute, Evolve: A Skill Acquisition and Reuse Loop for Embodied Agents
problem: Embodied agents repeatedly rediscover manipulation procedures instead of accumulating reusable capabilities.
assumption_broken: Exploration and execution can produce both textual guidance and reusable executable skills.
operational_signature: Explore task → execute with sensory feedback → extract guidance and code → register skills → reuse and extend
load_bearing_mechanism: The Explore-Execute-Evolve loop packages experience into skills that condition subsequent exploration and execution.
limitations_evident: Real-world evaluation uses 12 tasks with ten trials per task.
Exploration is task-driven rather than an unrestricted autonomous curriculum.

title: Learning Meta-Skills for Agent Harness Design in Test-Time AI4AI
problem: A builder can possess relevant facts yet construct poor external support for a target agent.
assumption_broken: The principles used to construct harnesses can be learned from downstream target outcomes while both models stay frozen.
operational_signature: Construct support → execute target → reflect on support failures → keep, revise, or add meta-skills → rebuild support for new tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: An editable meta-skill bank teaches the builder which burdens to externalize as state, tools, or control.

improver_modified.how: The builder revises external meta-skills that guide its future construction of target harnesses.

limitations_evident: Reported target budgets exclude builder construction compute.
Refinement is not monotonically beneficial.

title: MoFlow: Multi-Objective Agentic Workflow Generation
problem: A single scalar workflow objective cannot preserve useful quality, cost, and trust tradeoffs.
assumption_broken: One search can retain a reusable set of workflows for many later objective preferences.
operational_signature: Expand workflow tree → evaluate objective vectors → back up complementary candidates → retain frontier → select by preference
load_bearing_mechanism: Convex-hull MCTS uses set-valued backups to preserve workflows that serve different preferences.
limitations_evident: Online search is substantially more expensive than deploying a selected workflow.
Baseline comparison costs depend on how many preferences are rerun.

title: Component-Aware Feedback for Self-Evolving Programs
problem: Scalar fitness gives LLM program mutation little information about which code changes produced gains.
assumption_broken: Search memory can describe component-level changes and their measured effects rather than merely archive programs.
operational_signature: Mutate program → execute → compare component diffs and metric deltas → record attributed feedback → condition later mutations
load_bearing_mechanism: Parent-relative and seed-relative component feedback makes search history actionable for the mutation model.
limitations_evident: Component attribution relies on observed program comparisons rather than guaranteed causal isolation.

title: EvoSteer: Online Self-Evolving Graph Orchestration via Reference-Anchored Credit Assignment
problem: Fixed orchestration and coarse credit assignment cannot coordinate graph construction, execution repair, and reliable skill growth.
assumption_broken: A learned orchestrator can interleave structural decisions with execution rather than finish a graph before acting.
operational_signature: Construct and execute online → repair from outcomes → credit against a frozen reference → train controller → sequentially gate new skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Reference-anchored trajectory balance trains the orchestrator while paired sequential tests control skill admission.
limitations_evident: The learned controller and admission rule contribute distinct effects.

title: Toward Quantum Software Automation: A Quantum-Aware Harness for LLM-Guided Evolution
problem: Generic LLM evolution lacks the quantum workload context needed to improve executable quantum software.
assumption_broken: A domain-aware evaluation harness can improve mutation without changing the underlying evolutionary search engine.
operational_signature: Choose program → expose hard cases and profiles → mutate → execute proxy and quantum evaluations → retain improved candidates
load_bearing_mechanism: Quantum-aware workload coresets, profiles, and execution snapshots enrich mutation feedback.
limitations_evident: Final whole-suite evaluation includes the optimization subset.
Fitness depends on quantum-specific proxies and workloads.

title: RSIGame: Autonomous Agentic Game Development with Recursive Self-improvement
problem: Game-generation agents lack a reliable mechanism for iterative executable refinement and subsequent internalization.
assumption_broken: An initially generated game and the generator policy need not remain fixed after the first attempt.
operational_signature: Generate game → explore and diagnose → revise executable project and checklist → retain checkpoint → internalize refinement trajectories
load_bearing_mechanism: Structured play-driven refinement supplies trajectories for improving later game generation.
limitations_evident: The main refined artifact is a game project rather than an agent harness.
Repeated judging is not independent optimization-seed replication.

title: Schema: Discovering Unknown Environments via Agentic Program Induction
problem: Agents acting in unknown environments lack an executable predictive model of the transition rules.
assumption_broken: The environment model can be induced and revised as a persistent program during interaction.
operational_signature: Hypothesize rules → encode a world model → certify against transitions → plan and act → revise from mismatches
load_bearing_mechanism: Transition-history certification grounds executable world-model induction before planning.
limitations_evident: The persistent artifact is an environment model, not a repaired agent harness.

title: RefCon: Iterative Refinement and Contrastive Memory Extraction for Context-Evolving Agent
problem: Single-trajectory reflection confounds incidental actions with reusable causes of success.
assumption_broken: Sequential refinement and parallel contrast can jointly improve the experience from which memory is extracted.
operational_signature: Sample trajectories → refine failed attempts → contrast good and poor outcomes → distill memory → reuse on subsequent tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Contrasting refined trajectories makes memory extraction less dependent on one ambiguous rollout.
limitations_evident: Coding evaluation has sparse feedback.
Extraction uses a bounded number of trajectories.

title: Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery
problem: Sequential LLM-driven discovery can collapse onto a narrow initialization despite ample search budget.
assumption_broken: Search initialization is an experimental variable rather than an inconsequential setup detail.
operational_signature: Match budgets → compare parallel and sequential discovery → measure collapse → warm-start from parallel exploration → retest
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled initialization interventions isolate the benefit of diversity before sequential refinement.
limitations_evident: Conclusions are drawn from 12 modular discovery harnesses.

title: Pay for the Fault, Not the Flow: Label-Free In-Flow Multi-Agent Workflow Optimization
problem: Whole-workflow retries waste latency when only a small part of a multi-agent flow is faulty.
assumption_broken: Workflows can be repaired in flight using estimated competence and latency without labeled task outcomes.
operational_signature: Estimate competence and latency → decompose and assign work → identify local fault → repair cheapest affected flow → update profile
load_bearing_mechanism: A label-free competence-cost criterion directs localized in-flow optimization rather than rerunning the entire workflow.
limitations_evident: Competence is estimated without ground-truth labels.
The exact persistence policy is not fully established by the condensed source.

title: Mimir: Physics-Grounded LLM Agents for Long-Horizon Irrigation Control
problem: Long-horizon irrigation decisions need physical safety and learning from repeated control failures.
assumption_broken: Persistent language context can adapt while physics, safety bounds, and evaluation rules stay immutable.
operational_signature: Propose action → simulate and repair → execute bounded choice → distill recurring failures → update persistent context
load_bearing_mechanism: Fast simulator-checked action repair is separated from slow accumulation of reusable failure principles.
limitations_evident: Evidence is retrospective rather than a prospective irrigation deployment.
Chronological calibration covers a limited seasonal sequence.

title: Reliable Self-Evolution with Imperfect Proxy Rewards
problem: Evolution exploits proxy reward errors and retains candidates that fail high-fidelity evaluation.
assumption_broken: Archive admission need not trust raw proxy predictions under search-induced distribution shift.
operational_signature: Fit proxy-error bounds → calibrate intervals → estimate search shift → conservatively admit candidates → verify final outputs
load_bearing_mechanism: Conditional conformal error intervals and online density ratios make archive admission uncertainty-aware.
limitations_evident: Reliability depends on calibration and covariate-shift assumptions.
The gate filters materials candidates rather than whole agent updates.

title: DUET: Co-Evolving Solver and Grader Agents
problem: A fixed grader becomes misaligned as solver behavior changes, while solver-only optimization ignores evaluator defects.
assumption_broken: The grader is an editable agent whose evaluation practices should evolve with the solver.
operational_signature: Run solver and grader → inspect execution artifacts → alternate bounded solver and grader edits → select on labeled validation → test
load_bearing_mechanism: Reference-free artifact-grounded co-evolution is anchored by labeled validation for checkpoint selection and stopping.

improver_modified.how: Grader instructions and evaluation practices are revised alongside solver instructions.

limitations_evident: Reporting uses benchmark reference evaluators rather than human judgments.

title: SEER: Self-Evolving Event Reasoning and Retrieval for Time Series Forecasting
problem: Event-aware forecasting repeatedly retrieves noisy events and repeats causal reasoning mistakes.
assumption_broken: Prediction errors can update retrieval behavior and a reusable causal knowledge base without weight training.
operational_signature: Retrieve events → reason and forecast → observe error → revise retrieval guidance and causal memory → forecast later periods
load_bearing_mechanism: Chronologically bounded reflection converts prediction mistakes into persistent retrieval and causal guidance.
limitations_evident: Validity depends on strict chronological retrieval and reflection boundaries.

title: SHarP: Saliency-based Pruning of Agent Harnesses
problem: Agent harnesses accumulate modules whose cost is not justified by their marginal utility.
assumption_broken: Removing a module can preserve quality and improve efficiency instead of necessarily weakening the agent.
operational_signature: Identify removable modules → ablate on development tasks → estimate saliency and cost → prune → evaluate disjoint validation
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled module ablations drive saliency-based pruning under matched evaluation conditions.
limitations_evident: Removable modules are manually identified.
Study covers four harnesses and five settings.

title: When Is Enough Enough in Self-Evolving LLM Systems?
problem: Continuing self-evolution can degrade the final artifact even after validation performance has peaked.
assumption_broken: A fixed iteration budget and the last candidate are not necessarily the best stopping and output choices.
operational_signature: Collect paired candidate-incumbent outcomes → run anytime-valid detector → estimate change point → stop → return earlier artifact
load_bearing_mechanism: A restart-based sequential detector controls stopping and checkpoint choice using paired evidence.
limitations_evident: The method governs stopping and output selection rather than candidate generation.
Unseen reporting data are available only in some settings.

title: Building LLM Agent Systems the Deep Learning Way: From Modular Design to Architecture Search
problem: Hand-designed agent systems lack a systematic route from component optimization to architecture search.
assumption_broken: Agent systems can be treated as modular computation graphs with optimizable prompts and structure.
operational_signature: Define modular system → execute → propagate feedback → optimize component prompts → search and retain architectures
load_bearing_mechanism: The framework combines graph-based prompt optimization with neural-architecture-search-style structural choices.
limitations_evident: Final evaluation separation is not established in the condensed excerpts.

title: OOPMAS: Object-Oriented Multi-Agent Systems for Query-Level Workflow Generation
problem: Task-fixed workflows and fixed agent pools cannot adapt roles and control flow to individual queries.
assumption_broken: Both agent classes and the executable main workflow can be synthesized for a query.
operational_signature: Generate agent classes → compose Python workflow → execute and repair → distill lessons into run-local skills → regenerate
load_bearing_mechanism: Object-oriented agent and workflow synthesis is conditioned on a dynamic library of optimization experience.
limitations_evident: The skill library is run-local rather than persistent across deployments.
Query-specific code generation is expensive.
Weak backbones may generate unreliable workflows.

title: Test-Time Agent Evolution for Long-Horizon Legal Reasoning
problem: Static legal agent strategies fail across interdependent roles and long procedural contexts.
assumption_broken: Prior corrected legal workflows can be retrieved, adapted, and consolidated during test-time evolution.
operational_signature: Retrieve precedent → adapt role actions → verify against legal rubrics → correct execution → consolidate reusable cases
load_bearing_mechanism: Precedent reuse is coupled with role-level verification and consolidation of corrected procedures.
limitations_evident: Professional human-agent collaboration is not evaluated.

title: FreeEvolve: Learning to Evolve Beyond Fixed Loops
problem: Fixed evolution loops constrain how an agent allocates evidence, proposals, compute, and stopping decisions.
assumption_broken: The procedure running an improvement campaign can itself be an evolvable skill.
operational_signature: Run autonomous campaign → evaluate resulting worker → revise evolution skill → test on fresh targets → retain and recurse
load_bearing_mechanism: Meta-evolution selects editable campaign skills by the downstream performance of the workers they produce.

improver_modified.how: Meta-evolution rewrites the evolution skill that controls subsequent improvement campaigns.

limitations_evident: Effective evolution requires a sufficiently capable model.
Repeated worker evaluations are not necessarily independent meta-optimization seeds.

title: DuplexAgent-RSI: Recursive Harness Improvement for Full-Duplex Voice Agent Collaboration
problem: Full-duplex voice collaboration fails through timing, routing, and coordination defects outside model weights.
assumption_broken: The collaboration harness can be revised between simulated conversations while the participating models stay fixed.
operational_signature: Generate timed conversations → execute → attribute failures to modules → patch code or instructions → paired-test and protect → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Module-local failure attribution and paired protection gates drive six editable collaboration modules.
limitations_evident: Simulator conversations may not capture live conversational variability.

title: JANUS: Enhancing Long-Horizon Autonomous Research with Co-Evolving World Models
problem: Long-horizon autonomous research wastes experiments when it cannot predict the value of proposed research steps.
assumption_broken: The research world model and its exploration guidance can evolve from experiment outcomes.
operational_signature: Propose research DAG steps → predict value and information → execute selected experiments → distill feedback into skills → update predictions
load_bearing_mechanism: A co-evolving world model uses outcome-derived research, exploration, and coordination skills to guide search.

improver_modified.how: Experimental feedback revises world-model exploration and coordination skills that guide later research search.

limitations_evident: Evidence covers 30 benchmark tasks and three real research tasks.

title: From Agents to Edges: Paired Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration
problem: Optimizing isolated agent prompts misses failures caused by their communication interfaces.
assumption_broken: The edge joining two agents can be optimized as a paired instruction-and-protocol unit.
operational_signature: Select collaboration edge → jointly revise endpoints and conventions → evaluate staged outcomes → update bandit → retain improvement
load_bearing_mechanism: Paired endpoint optimization assigns credit to inter-agent communication rather than individual roles alone.
limitations_evident: Main PACO result uses seed zero.
The topology and model family remain fixed.
Optimized instructions increase deployment token cost.

title: Memorizing Who, Knowing How: Benchmarking Personal and Procedural Memory for Persistent Assistants
problem: Persistent assistants must maintain user facts and procedures together, including the associations between them.
assumption_broken: Memory evaluation cannot be reduced to independent fact recall or procedure retrieval.
operational_signature: Stream personal and procedural interactions → update joint memory → evaluate persistent tasks and associations → train location-aware manager
load_bearing_mechanism: PraxisMemBench tests joint memory maintenance, and PraxisMem trains organization using location-aware rewards and privileged residual supervision.
limitations_evident: Some component ablations use a fixed eight-trajectory subset.
Training uses privileged canonical memory-state supervision.

title: HarnessPAI: An Evolving Harness for Physical AI
problem: Physical foundation models lack task-specific control logic and repeat failures across rollouts.
assumption_broken: A robot policy can be supported by executable code that evolves between rollouts without changing during a rollout.
operational_signature: Execute fixed rollout program → diagnose failure → patch harness → record failure-repair skill graph → evaluate unseen seeds
load_bearing_mechanism: Executable harness edits turn physical feedback into reusable control behavior and can later supply expert fine-tuning data.
limitations_evident: Weight fine-tuning is optional rather than required by the evolution loop.

title: RLHarness: Co-evolving Procedural Skills with Reinforcement Learning for Long-horizon Multimodal Reasoning
problem: Procedural skills become stale as multimodal reasoning policies change during training.
assumption_broken: External procedures and learned weights should be version-aligned rather than optimized independently once.
operational_signature: Build skill program → collect rollouts → train with SFT and DAPO → inspect new failures → reconstruct skills → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Fresh outcomes after policy training rebuild versioned skills, protocols, examples, and task contracts.
limitations_evident: Only two update cycles are evaluated.
Visual-reading errors and coarse terminal feedback remain.

title: EvoIn: Bridging Evolution and Internalization for Agent Fine-Tuning
problem: Harness evolution helps a model only while the evolved external procedure is available.
assumption_broken: Procedural gains can be internalized from verified guided rollouts rather than retained only as context.
operational_signature: Evolve decision procedure → execute guided rollouts → verify successes → rewrite self-contained reasoning → fine-tune → deploy seed harness
load_bearing_mechanism: Runtime-guided successes are transformed into self-contained reasoning traces for weight-level internalization.
limitations_evident: Evolution selection data also serve as the final in-distribution test.
A stronger external agent guides evolution.

title: PrivMeSA: Privacy-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Medicine via Local-Remote LLM Collaboration
problem: Local medical agents need remote expertise without exposing identifying patient details.
assumption_broken: Lessons distilled from consultations can reduce future remote dependence while disclosure control is learned locally.
operational_signature: Train disclosure controller → consult remote expert → distill local lesson → retrieve at most one useful lesson → solve later encounters
load_bearing_mechanism: Privacy-aware local control is paired with persistent consultation-derived memory.
limitations_evident: Evaluation is retrospective on medical records.
Memory accumulation is evaluated in a single chronological-within-patient pass.

title: Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization for Multimodal Clinical Diagnosis
problem: Correctness-oriented prompt evolution does not align with clinical ranking metrics such as AUROC.
assumption_broken: The elementary selection row can be a positive-negative ranking event rather than one classified instance.
operational_signature: Evaluate prompts → construct pair-ranking scores → issue ranking-shaped feedback → preserve pairwise Pareto candidates → evolve prompts
load_bearing_mechanism: Pair-level ranking events align both Pareto selection and reflective feedback with the AUROC objective.
limitations_evident: Selection uses the split called held-out in the method; final reporting separation is unclear.
Evaluation covers three diseases and two model families on one medical data source.

title: Not All Experience Belongs in the Weights: Component Routing for Self-Improving GUI Agents
problem: Whole-trajectory learning obscures which experience components belong in context and which belong in weights.
assumption_broken: The destination of experience can be chosen by component rather than fixed for an entire trajectory.
operational_signature: Split experience into components → route identical items to context or weights → compare matched conditions → fit routing rule → test held-out family
load_bearing_mechanism: Controlled same-item interventions reveal recurrence and state-conditionality as routing properties.
limitations_evident: Routing conclusions are tested on three backbone families and two environments.

title: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement for Frontier Reasoning Data Synthesis
problem: Fixed task-synthesis procedures stop producing difficult valid reasoning tasks as generation progresses.
assumption_broken: The task generator harness and the tasks it produces can evolve together with fixed models and verifiers.
operational_signature: Generate and verify tasks → diagnose solver and synthesis failures → edit skills and workflow → gate candidate harness → seed next round
load_bearing_mechanism: Online failure-derived skills and post-batch harness revisions jointly improve the next task-generation round.

improver_modified.how: The synthesis harness revises its own task-transformation skills and generation workflow between batches.

limitations_evident: A finite 14-round trajectory does not establish convergence.
Combined schedule ablations do not isolate the admission gate itself.

title: AIProver: Agentic Auto-Formalization of Mathematical Research via Certificate-Driven Evolving Harness
problem: Research auto-formalization fails semantically and operationally despite syntactically valid proof attempts.
assumption_broken: Verifier certificates can coordinate alternating harness repair and model training.
operational_signature: Attempt formalization → inspect diagnostic certificates → evolve harness → train policy → test held-out fitness → retain or roll back
load_bearing_mechanism: Certificate-driven HarnessEvolve alternates with reinforcement learning using disjoint training subsets and gated updates.
limitations_evident: Held-out fitness is used for round admission, so its role must be distinguished from independent reporting.
Semantic alignment and executable verification address different error classes.

title: SkillForge: Co-Evolving Skills and Agents via Dynamic Skill Lifecycles
problem: Skills that once helped can become redundant or harmful as the agent policy learns.
assumption_broken: A skill library should retire obsolete entries instead of monotonically growing during policy training.
operational_signature: Estimate episode skill fitness → retire obsolete entries → stabilize useful skills → mutate with teacher → train policy → reassess
load_bearing_mechanism: Trial, active, stable, and retired states govern skill lifecycles jointly with GRPO policy evolution.
limitations_evident: Each configuration uses one RL training seed.
Five evaluation sampling seeds are not independent training runs.
Episode-level fitness approximates individual skill utility.

title: CoTrace: Data Recipes for Training Terminal Agents with Harness-Model Co-Evolution
problem: Terminal-agent training data mismatch the runtime harness and fail to preserve useful evolution provenance.
assumption_broken: Harness search and model training can share a verified, runtime-aligned data recipe.
operational_signature: Search harness → route failures to synthesis → verify successful rollouts → train with SFT and fresh RL → evaluate promotion → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Provenance-aware routing separates harness repair data from verified runtime-matched policy-training data.
limitations_evident: The 102-task promotion split is used for adoption and is not an untouched final holdout.

title: Self-Healing Harness for Runtime Oversight of Agent Self-Modification
problem: An agent can fix its triggering failure while harming protected behaviors through a persistent rule.
assumption_broken: Proposing self-modification and authorizing its persistence should be separate responsibilities.
operational_signature: Detect failure → propose rule → replay triggering and protected cases → require improvement and non-regression → audit accumulated corpus
load_bearing_mechanism: An external runtime controls persistence with replay-based improvement, protected-case tests, and corpus-level checks.
limitations_evident: Analysis includes only trials completed in both arms.
Each validation round checks at most two protected cases.
Individually accepted rules can still degrade cumulatively.

title: Multi-Agent System Search via Active Substructure-aware Policy Optimization
problem: Query-specific multi-agent search wastes training on easy queries and gives poor credit to structural choices.
assumption_broken: Graph-construction policies can focus training on competence-boundary queries and credit relevant descendants.
operational_signature: Select active query → construct graph → execute descendants → assign substructure-aware reward → optimize graph policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Active query selection and descendant-subgraph rewards train a PPO architecture constructor.
limitations_evident: Results cover six benchmarks and a bounded architecture search space.

title: WeaveData: A Multimodal Data Analysis System with Self-Critiquing and Self-Evolving LLM Plans
problem: Multimodal analysis plans can silently answer the wrong question or repeat failed computation.
assumption_broken: Plans can critique semantic alignment before execution and reuse valid intermediate results after failure.
operational_signature: Build typed plan → critique against question → execute → repair failed steps while reusing results → accumulate planning experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Pre-execution semantic critique and failure-specific repair prevent invalid plans from being repeatedly executed.
limitations_evident: Evidence is an end-to-end demonstration on two datasets.
Persistent experience maintenance is less specified than within-query repair.

title: Video2Skill: From Streaming Experience to Reusable Embodied Skills
problem: Streaming embodied observations require skill creation and reuse rather than isolated video captioning.
assumption_broken: A persistent symbolic skill library can be evaluated as an evolving state across a video stream.
operational_signature: Observe segment → decide create or reuse → update symbolic library → process later segments → score library and event coverage
load_bearing_mechanism: Source-video-disjoint streaming evaluation separates correct reuse from expansion, while a supervised manager learns library decisions.
limitations_evident: Skills are symbolic schemas rather than executable controllers.
Models struggle to expand libraries for novel content.

title: MobiAgent: Dual-Loop Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
problem: Long-horizon mobile manipulation requires robust online recovery and continued improvement from deployment rollouts.
assumption_broken: A shared low-level skill policy can improve from automatically curated execution data rather than remain fixed.
operational_signature: Plan with high-level model → execute and recover with skill policy → segment and verify rollouts → curate data → fine-tune policy
load_bearing_mechanism: An inner planning-and-recovery loop supplies automatically curated skill-policy training data to an outer loop.
limitations_evident: New skills can interfere with previously trained behaviors.
Pose correction and critic drift persist.
Broader embodiments and task families remain unevaluated.

title: Self-Propagating Misalignment in LLM Agents, and Why Auditing or Disabling Memory Is Not Enough
problem: Misaligned behavior can persist after a model is replaced because its written artifacts influence later aligned agents.
assumption_broken: Auditing or disabling the explicit memory store is not sufficient when ordinary files also transmit goals.
operational_signature: Induce author misalignment → write persistent artifacts → hand off to aligned reader → test propagation and defenses → repeat sessions
load_bearing_mechanism: Cross-agent handoffs isolate memories and ordinary files as channels for persistent behavioral contamination.
limitations_evident: Attacks are studied in constructed scenarios.
The reported defense does not eliminate propagation.

title: ForkPilot: Self-Evolving Policy for Retrospective Search in Long-Horizon Agents
problem: Delayed outcomes and changing execution evidence make retrospective-search effort difficult to allocate.
assumption_broken: A search-value policy can be updated from completed trajectories instead of remaining fixed after offline learning.
operational_signature: Construct outcome comparisons → learn offline search policy → choose search from current observations → incorporate new trajectories → update policy
load_bearing_mechanism: Search Value Dynamics motivates offline policy learning followed by trajectory-driven online policy updates.
limitations_evident: Abstract-only source; implementation and evaluation protocol are unavailable.
The representation and update rule of the learned search policy are unspecified.

title: DAEDALUS: Bootstrapping Agent Memory from Self-Generated Tasks
problem: Agents lack reusable experience when curated practice tasks or oracle feedback are unavailable.
assumption_broken: Self-generated practice can bootstrap external memory without updating model parameters.
operational_signature: Generate practice tasks → attempt solutions → derive failure heuristics → validate through repeated success → consolidate memory → deploy frozen model
load_bearing_mechanism: Self-generated task experience becomes heuristics only after repeat-success validation.
limitations_evident: Practice-time judgments can be imperfect despite checks against official verifiers.

title: ScienceClaw: Benchmarking Continual Self-Evolution of AI-for-Science Agents Across the Natural and Social Sciences
problem: AI-for-science evaluation rarely measures cumulative executable improvement, retention, transfer, and evolution cost together.
assumption_broken: Scientific agents should be evaluated as persistent programs over streams rather than independent fixed task solvers.
operational_signature: Execute scientific stream → diagnose failure → verify repair → register linked skills and operators → replay and gate → reset-evaluate snapshots
load_bearing_mechanism: Sequential program evolution is paired with independent reset evaluations and explicit source-replay and transfer gates.
limitations_evident: Reported trajectories are final snapshots rather than broad repeated-run evidence.
Automated evaluators can miss domain errors.
Retained executable updates expand the attack surface.

title: Generative Adversarial Loops
problem: Algorithm discovery optimizes against stale benchmarks that fail to expose newly relevant failure modes.
assumption_broken: The adversarial discriminator or benchmark can evolve along with the candidate algorithm.
operational_signature: Search adversarial cases → expose algorithm failure → generate algorithm revisions → evaluate robustness → refresh discriminator
load_bearing_mechanism: Alternating adversarial-data and algorithm search continually moves the empirical goalposts.
limitations_evident: Adversarial effort certifies robustness only for the specified search procedure.
No proposer-solver weight co-training is established.

title: Use and Disuse: Intent-Structured Experience Consolidation for Memory and Learning in LLM Agents
problem: Flat memory loses intent structure and makes long-horizon consolidation and recall increasingly costly.
assumption_broken: Memory can retain a recoverable original tree while recursively compressing older completed intentions.
operational_signature: Track nested intents → consolidate completed intent → abstract older prefix → progressively recall source details → reconsolidate used memory
load_bearing_mechanism: Intent-structured hierarchical consolidation preserves recoverability while controlling the active context.
limitations_evident: Some target-domain gains have limited headroom.
Reported task experiments share one backbone.

title: A Self-Defining Operator for Distributed Applications
problem: Incident responders repeatedly rediscover diagnoses for recurring faults.
assumption_broken: Operational procedures and dispatch detectors can be authored from resolved incidents rather than fixed by engineers.
operational_signature: resolve incident → distill playbook and detector → commit operational memory → dispatch and reuse on recurrence
load_bearing_mechanism: Pair reusable diagnostic playbooks with inexpensive executable detectors that trigger their retrieval.
limitations_evident: Evaluation covers eleven microservice applications.

title: Visible but Not Avoided: State-Dependent Re-Proposal of Rejected Candidates in Catalog-Based LLM Optimization Loops
problem: Optimization wastes iterations proposing already rejected edits.
assumption_broken: Avoidance on static rejection probes need not predict avoidance in optimizer-generated states.
operational_signature: run catalog search → reconstruct encountered states → intervene on rejection history → measure repeated proposals
load_bearing_mechanism: Measure rejection avoidance on self-selected rejected sets and contrast explicit rejection wording with neutral histories.
limitations_evident: One synthetic GUI agent and one forty-edit catalog
Free-text optimizers are not studied.

title: EvoOntology: A Self-Evolving Ontology Layer for Data Agents
problem: Generic tools and static semantic layers leave a gap between data agents and heterogeneous sources.
assumption_broken: The ontology schema, content and exposure tools can evolve with the backbone's observed failures.
operational_signature: construct ontology → attribute trajectory failures → apply typed edit → paired backbone-specific gate → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Backbone-conditional paired evaluation authorizes bounded changes to an interactive ontology.
limitations_evident: The reported benchmark and backbone counts differ between abstract and experiments.

title: VIEWCRAFT: Evolving What Multimodal Agents See and How They Read It
problem: Multimodal skills fail when required evidence is missing or unreadable.
assumption_broken: What the agent sees is an editable component, coupled to how the agent reads it.
operational_signature: inspect failure traces → revise renderer and reader → replay and compare → retain paired improvement
load_bearing_mechanism: Jointly evolve executable evidence construction and its reading procedure rather than instructions alone.
limitations_evident: Evidence depends on the renderer's permitted observation and budget interfaces.

title: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting
problem: Discovery agents plateau as accumulated search history anchors later proposals.
assumption_broken: More retained search history is not always useful for scaling discovery.
operational_signature: search in parallel → keep best candidate → discard sessions and history → restart search
load_bearing_mechanism: Periodically reset search state while preserving the best candidate.
limitations_evident: Full text unavailable
abstract-only extraction.

title: Beyond Aggregate Accuracy: Item-Level Transitions in Prompt Optimization
problem: Aggregate accuracy hides regressions and outcome churn during prompt optimization.
assumption_broken: Prompt feedback should include item-level transitions rather than only aggregate scores.
operational_signature: evaluate prompt → identify recovered and regressed items → reflect and rewrite → validate → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Return item-level recovery and regression evidence to the prompt reviser.
limitations_evident: Validation data also supply feedback after the first round
Held-out gains are smaller than validation gains.

title: Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay
problem: Single attempts provide ambiguous lessons and uncurated memory eventually harms agents.
assumption_broken: Experience should be contrasted and consolidated rather than appended as isolated lessons.
operational_signature: compare attempts on same task → diagnose reusable decisions → merge overlaps and conflicts → retrieve revised guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: Replay-based comparisons revise applicability conditions while consolidating related memories.
limitations_evident: Full text unavailable
abstract-only extraction.

title: Learning to Compose: Recursive Self-Improvement of Shared Executable Stacks for Zero-Shot Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
problem: Individually competent robot skills fail at composition boundaries.
assumption_broken: The shared tools, contracts, handoffs and verifiers are the reusable unit of improvement, not task-specific programs.
operational_signature: execute source compositions → attribute violated contract → repair shared stack → regression gate → freeze and transfer
load_bearing_mechanism: Repair compositional interfaces and shared executable components using paired selection and regression tests.
limitations_evident: Physical resets and ground-truth diagnosis may be costly or unavailable
Zero-shot transfer permits shared skills and objects.

title: InstAgent: A Recursively Self-Improving Agent Operating System for Heterogeneous Robot Collaboration
problem: Heterogeneous robots lose corrections and mishandle cross-robot dependencies.
assumption_broken: Collaboration programs can be retained and revised as reusable executable subtrees.
operational_signature: compose behavior tree → execute and diagnose → revise and resume → verify → save reusable subtree
load_bearing_mechanism: Persist corrected collaboration behavior trees with applicability documents and handoff checks.
limitations_evident: Evaluation reuses a fixed robot team.

title: The World Won't Wait: Evaluating and Teaching Agents Under a Live Clock
problem: Slow deliberation makes otherwise correct decisions arrive too late.
assumption_broken: Powerful reasoning can occur offline while a fast actor executes distilled guidance.
operational_signature: collect live failures → teacher practices paused corrections → write guidance → validate → deploy fast actor
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate slow offline instruction improvement from fast live action selection.
limitations_evident: Games use structured text observations rather than raw pixels
The benchmark covers six game types.

title: D-World: An Explicit World-Language-Action Model with Recursive Self-Improvement under Dual Control
problem: Implicit robot world models cannot be inspected or corrected from measurements.
assumption_broken: An explicit executable scene and physical parameters can be revised online without retraining.
operational_signature: construct twin → plan and execute chunk → compare measurements → replay candidate correction → accept non-regression
load_bearing_mechanism: Accept local twin revisions only when replay residuals remain within non-regression tolerances.
limitations_evident: Limited to quasi-static tasks and simulator-supported physics
Replay guarantees apply only to the latest chunk.

title: ECG-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Targeted Electrocardiogram Waveform Evolution
problem: ECG supervision fails to target changing weaknesses while remaining waveform-grounded.
assumption_broken: Data construction rules and training recipes should change with diagnosed learner errors.
operational_signature: diagnose errors → synthesize waveform contrasts → remeasure validity → train candidate → select on separate data
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate measurement-grounded generator repair from empirical selection of useful training interventions.
limitations_evident: Continued feedback correction yields diminishing external gains.

title: Multimodal Filesystem Memory For Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
problem: Long-horizon summaries discard visual details while raw histories are difficult to search.
assumption_broken: Text indexes and consolidated knowledge can preserve links to original multimodal observations.
operational_signature: record multimodal episodes → index contextual cues → retrieve original evidence → consolidate linked knowledge
load_bearing_mechanism: Connect searchable textual memory to raw multimodal episodes through a filesystem hierarchy.
limitations_evident: Evaluation spans Minecraft and computer-use environments.

title: Self-Building Labs
problem: Laboratory automation cannot execute procedures beyond its manually engineered capabilities.
assumption_broken: Lab layouts, twins, control interfaces and skills can be generated for a scientific objective.
operational_signature: inspect available lab → identify missing capability → build and test interfaces or skills → compose experiment
load_bearing_mechanism: Build the missing executable laboratory capabilities instead of assuming a fixed automated lab.
limitations_evident: End-to-end physical validation centers on quantum-dot synthesis.

title: Can LLMs predict the outcomes of machine learning experiments?
problem: Research agents lack reliable estimates of which proposed ML experiments are worth running.
assumption_broken: An experiment proposer's intuition can be measured against executed outcomes.
operational_signature: collect proposed experiments → predict score changes → implement and train → compare predicted and measured effects
load_bearing_mechanism: Evaluate pre-run predictions of self-generated experimental interventions against realized training outcomes.
limitations_evident: Failed runs and unusable predictions are excluded
Eight MLE-bench Lite tasks bound the evaluation.

title: DarKnight: Retrieval-Guided Agentic Framework for Breaking Dark Web CAPTCHA Gates
problem: Local vision models struggle with varied CAPTCHA distortions and uniform preprocessing can degrade answers.
assumption_broken: Prior successful and failed attempts can guide instance-specific tool orchestration without fine-tuning.
operational_signature: retrieve comparable attempts → compose preprocessing → execute recognition → observe verdict → store experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Use dual-signal retrieval of successful and failed cases to choose selective preprocessing.
limitations_evident: Case study covers four marketplaces.

title: Scalable Weak-to-Strong Verifier Hardening for Agent Environments
problem: Hackable verifiers award rewards without legitimate task completion.
assumption_broken: Verifier implementations and runtime boundaries can be iteratively repaired before stronger attackers arrive.
operational_signature: isolate grader → search exploit → patch verifier or runtime → validate legitimate solutions → repeat attacks
load_bearing_mechanism: Alternate hacker and fixer agents while preserving valid solution routes under an isolated verifier.
limitations_evident: Robustness is measured against the evaluated attacker models and attack budgets.

title: CoDA: Co-Evolution of Data Engines and Action Policies
problem: Physically valid generated environments need not provide useful robot training.
assumption_broken: Failure diagnoses can jointly specify generation programs and training supervision.
operational_signature: collect policy failures → validate critic diagnoses → compile scenes and shaped potentials → train policy → measure progress
load_bearing_mechanism: Compile shared failure memory into complementary generation and training programs.
limitations_evident: Potential-based shaping relies on stated standard assumptions.

title: COLLEAGUE.SKILL: Automated AI Skill Generation via Expert Knowledge Distillation
problem: Person-grounded expertise is scattered across heterogeneous traces rather than usable instructions.
assumption_broken: Expert practices and bounded interaction style can be packaged as inspectable portable skills.
operational_signature: collect authorized traces → extract expertise → build versioned skill package → correct and install → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Distill capability and bounded behavior into coordinated, correctable skill-package tracks.
limitations_evident: Description emphasizes an implemented system and gallery rather than controlled task evaluation.

title: LVMH: A Meta-Optimization Harness for Long-Video Agent Memory
problem: Hand-designed long-video memory policies poorly balance context, latency and accuracy.
assumption_broken: The memory policy itself can be searched as executable code under protected observation boundaries.
operational_signature: record research history → propose memory policy → implement in sandbox → independent audit → promote frontier
load_bearing_mechanism: Search answer-time memory designs with independent review and persistent meta-memory.

improver_modified.how: The outer code-search loop redesigns the inner answer-time memory policy.

limitations_evident: Policy evolution begins on EgoLifeQA before transfer evaluation.

title: Federation over Harness
problem: Distributed reflection pipelines rely on manually fixed local and global harnesses.
assumption_broken: The server's aggregation and update harness can evolve along with client harnesses.
operational_signature: clients solve and reflect → server edits own harness → aggregate insights → update client harness → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: A server evolves its own improvement procedure using distributed self-reflections without validation labels.

improver_modified.how: The server rewrites its own harness for aggregation and subsequent client-harness improvement.

limitations_evident: Evolution has no external validation signal for candidate acceptance.

title: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
problem: Optimizing every agent wastes resources and failure responsibility does not identify improvement potential.
assumption_broken: Black-box response to controlled prompt perturbations can prioritize where to spend optimization budget.
operational_signature: perturb each agent prompt → measure end-to-end loss → fit local response → rank agents → improve selected agent
load_bearing_mechanism: Use a geometry-aware response norm to estimate system-level intervention opportunity.
limitations_evident: Probing incurs additional full-workflow executions
Continuous directions are not directly converted into discrete edits.

title: Selm: Self-Evolving Library Management for Multi-Skill Agent Optimization
problem: Evolved skills accumulate without reliable retrieval or lifecycle management.
assumption_broken: Skill confidence and measured utility should govern updates, retention and removal.
operational_signature: retrieve by utility → collect task traces → map-reduce targeted edits → update confidence → prune and validate library
load_bearing_mechanism: Jointly manage skill retrieval and lifecycle using distinct utility and confidence signals.
limitations_evident: Gains are reported across four agent benchmarks.

title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
problem: Research investigations lose continuity and lessons across bounded model sessions.
assumption_broken: Hierarchical memories, saved branches and independent review can sustain an ongoing investigation.
operational_signature: run experiments → preserve branches and lessons → independently review progress → retrieve across sessions → continue
load_bearing_mechanism: Combine hierarchical persistent research memory with versioned alternatives and independent review.
limitations_evident: Record claims use literature references available on a stated cutoff
Research campaigns use problem-specific budgets.

title: CoEvo-RSI: When Harnesses Evolve, Which Models Should Follow?
problem: A changed harness can demand behaviors its inherited model cannot execute.
assumption_broken: Harness ancestry and model checkpoint ancestry can be selected jointly rather than coupled by recency.
operational_signature: retrieve historical designs → select or merge model checkpoints → adapt on harness trajectories → evaluate → archive pair
load_bearing_mechanism: Bidirectional historical inheritance aligns model capabilities with evolving harness requirements.
limitations_evident: Experiments use three application domains and rejection-sampled SFT.

title: Compile Once, Run Cheap: Frozen, Portable Skills for Embodied Agents, and What Recursive Self-Improvement Adds
problem: Embodied capability otherwise requires demonstrations or costly frontier-model inference every episode.
assumption_broken: A strong model can compile skills offline and leave deployment to code or a cheap caller.
operational_signature: write skill → practice and repair in simulation → freeze files → hidden-layout qualification → reuse unchanged
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate offline audited skill compilation from frozen executable reuse across executor families.
limitations_evident: Three of seven tasks did not compile
No direct-control baseline was run
The gate requires high success and zero safety aborts.

title: Memory as Belief: Bayesian Evolution of Memory for Self-Evolving LLM Agents
problem: Historical memory success rates ignore context dependence and uncertainty.
assumption_broken: Memory utility can be a context-conditioned belief calibrated by counterfactual evidence.
operational_signature: infer memory-value belief → retrieve and synthesize → execute → leave-one-out credit → update estimator
load_bearing_mechanism: A LoRA-adapted Beta-belief estimator learns memory value from combination-aware counterfactual outcomes.
limitations_evident: Task streams retain both memory and estimator across stages.

title: Trackable Skill Library Lifecycle Management for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
problem: Co-retrieved skills obscure individual causal utility as policy learning changes their value.
assumption_broken: Skill contribution and model mastery can be tracked with randomized within-task contrasts.
operational_signature: randomize skill injection → collect grouped outcomes → estimate utility and mastery → gate lifecycle transitions → train
load_bearing_mechanism: Use within-GRPO randomized contrasts to govern admission, incubation, retention and retirement.
limitations_evident: Evaluation is on ALFWorld and AppWorld with a shared base model.

title: Let Them Sleep: Recursive Self-Pruning Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
problem: Growing stores preserve failed approaches and stale facts that agents repeat.
assumption_broken: Memory consolidation can replace raw episodes rather than add another layer above them.
operational_signature: cluster recent failures → distill constraints → delete source episodes → decay and promote rules → retrieve
load_bearing_mechanism: Periodic sleep cycles combine abstraction with deletion, decay and cross-context promotion.
limitations_evident: Software-engineering results use a calibrated simulation rather than full coding runs
The three studies use separately tuned hyperparameters.

title: Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness
problem: Plans and intermediate work can drift away from the user's original objective.
assumption_broken: The original goal can remain a fixed reference while work graphs and execution records change.
operational_signature: plan scoped work → execute workers → review against original goal → request revision → refine instructions
load_bearing_mechanism: Keep objective, revisable plan and execution record separate in a planner-worker-reviewer harness.
limitations_evident: Complete configurations use selected role models
The paired clinical gain raises inference cost substantially.

title: Are Self-Evolving Agents Continual Learners?
problem: Aggregate self-evolution gains conceal forgetting and interference under distribution drift.
assumption_broken: Nonparametric self-evolution must be evaluated for continual-learning stability, not only plasticity.
operational_signature: construct drifting task stream → evolve shared harness → probe past and unseen groups → measure forgetting
load_bearing_mechanism: Compare retrieval and global self-modification on controlled topic, workflow and domain shifts.
limitations_evident: Evaluation uses three representative methods and four constructed stream types.

title: EvoSkill v2: Fully Agentic Skill Evolution from Benchmark Adaptation to a Stateful Evolver
problem: Stateless skill optimizers lose context and noisy scores can reject useful edits.
