assumption_broken: The evolver can be a persistent coding agent and accept each epoch rather than noisy winner selection.
operational_signature: adapt benchmark → collect repeated solver attempts → persistent evolver revises skills → accept epoch → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Retain one stateful evolver across epochs and expose repeated task rollouts instead of isolated calls.
limitations_evident: The study uses two benchmarks
Every epoch is accepted without a keep-if-better gate.

title: Understanding When Reflective Prompt and Skill Optimization Helps on Locally Served Reasoning Models: A Two-Model Study of GEPA and SkillOpt
problem: Reflective optimization gains may not replicate on locally served reasoning models.
assumption_broken: Serving configuration, task and answer realization can determine whether textual optimization helps.
operational_signature: freeze serving protocol → optimize prompts or skills → compare matched held-out conditions → audit reliability and cost
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate held-out optimizer effects from validation gains and serving-completion sensitivity.
limitations_evident: Only two target-serving configurations and two benchmarks
An earlier run is retained as sensitivity evidence.

title: VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement
problem: Research agents must coordinate data, training and inference changes instead of optimizing isolated components.
assumption_broken: The editable object can be the entire target-agent training and inference system.
operational_signature: provide identical base system → iterate under budget using validation → submit final system → isolated hidden test
load_bearing_mechanism: Benchmark cross-component co-design with isolated test data, grading containers and restricted research networking.
limitations_evident: Runs require eight A100 GPUs
Editable components differ by benchmark task.

title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
problem: Harness performance improvements often increase execution costs.
assumption_broken: Search should retain deployment-budget alternatives rather than a single accuracy winner.
operational_signature: diagnose traces → propose cost-diverse patches → score with generated tests → select lite medium heavy → iterate
load_bearing_mechanism: Normalized weighted squared-distance selection preserves harnesses for distinct performance-cost priorities.
limitations_evident: Evolution uses generated tests instead of official solutions and tests.

title: BetaMem: Learning to Remember a Changing World for Embodied Agents
problem: Embodied memory records become distorted, temporally confused and expensive.
assumption_broken: Memory-operation rules can be diagnosed and repaired instead of remaining fixed.
operational_signature: write source-grounded records → diagnose operation-chain failures → repair local rule → independent replay → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Combine a traceable write contract with independently replay-gated repairs to memory rules.

improver_modified.how: The abstract describes failure-driven local repair of memory-operation rules, gated by independent replay.

limitations_evident: Full text unavailable
abstract-only extraction.

title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
problem: High physical task scores obscure improvement speed, interaction cost and what is retained.
assumption_broken: Physical RSI should be measured by progress profiles and workspace interventions rather than final success alone.
operational_signature: run bounded physical attempts → measure five-axis profiles → remove or freeze workspace → test new layouts and tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Intervene on persistent workspaces to distinguish retained experience from scene-specific adaptation.
limitations_evident: Cross-task transfer is demonstrated in three cases
Observational scaling does not establish a causal capability law.

title: Evolving Self-tuning Benchmarks for Long-Horizon Tool Use
problem: Static tool-use suites are limited, difficult to scale and poorly targeted to solver competence.
assumption_broken: Executable benchmark tasks can evolve toward difficult but solvable instances without training the proposer.
operational_signature: mutate task program → sample solver attempts → summarize failures → score difficulty → archive and filter tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Gradient-free task evolution targets intermediate empirical completion rates and diverse failure modes.
limitations_evident: Solver training is proposed as a future extension, not the main experiment.

title: Unsupervised Tool Evolution for Coding Agents in Data-Lake Analytics
problem: Data-lake agents repeat data discovery and preparation without reusable tools or answer labels.
assumption_broken: Execution adoption and supported answer changes can gate useful tools without ground-truth labels.
operational_signature: explore lake and inspect traces → propose missing tools → implement and update usage skills → rerun → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Complementary explorer and critic proposals are accepted only after evidence-based rerun verification.
limitations_evident: Frozen transfer is within the same data lake.

title: REM: What to Store, When to Recall, What to Forget in Experience Memory for Coding Agents
problem: Retrieval cannot decide when a running coding agent actually needs detailed experience.
assumption_broken: Recall timing and eviction can be in-loop control decisions rather than fixed context injection.
operational_signature: consolidate completed trace → inject phase document → detect struggle → expose implementation once → evict
load_bearing_mechanism: An in-loop gate delays detailed precedent until needed and removes it after one exposure.
limitations_evident: Evaluation uses 99 tasks and a 300-trajectory pool from SWE-ContextBench Lite.

title: More Memory, Worse Agents: Error Reproduction and Anti-Persistence in LLM Agents
problem: Persistent inferred guidance can reproduce its own errors through future trajectories.
assumption_broken: Raw experience may persist while abstractions are reconstructed and discarded each task.
operational_signature: accumulate trajectories → choose synthesis mode → create temporary guidance → execute → discard abstraction
load_bearing_mechanism: Separate persistent episode storage from nonpersistent guidance using an outcome-adaptive selector.
limitations_evident: Indirect feedback through retained trajectories remains possible.

title: KPHarness: Co-Evolving Knowledge and Probing for Long-Horizon Gaming Harnesses
problem: Terminal failure alone does not identify which gaming-harness intervention is needed.
assumption_broken: How the harness investigates failures can improve along with recovery knowledge.
operational_signature: observe failure → select diagnostic probe → revise recovery hypothesis → paired-test harness → update probing policies
load_bearing_mechanism: Co-evolve recovery knowledge and active probing so later harness edits use better diagnostic evidence.

improver_modified.how: Feedback updates action- and knowledge-probing policies that determine diagnostic evidence for later harness revisions.

limitations_evident: The gaming policy is trained first and frozen during harness adaptation.

title: Harness Self-Evolution for Long-Horizon Terminal Agents
problem: Long-horizon agents exhibit unreliable repeated execution despite occasional success.
assumption_broken: Harness-internal traces and external implementations can localize fixable reliability mechanisms.
operational_signature: contrast successful and failed runs → localize with dual traces → research existing mechanisms → patch → repeatedly validate
load_bearing_mechanism: Combine runtime-monitor traces and a Harness Handbook to map recurring failures to editable harness code.
limitations_evident: Adaptation targets a fixed model rather than universal harness portability.

title: Recoverability and Verifier Strength: Two Measured Preconditions for Unattended Agent Self-Improvement
problem: An apparently healthy verifier may approve everything and an undo may not restore behavior.
assumption_broken: Unattended change needs measured verifier strength and recoverability rather than assumed reversibility.
operational_signature: measure gate against trusted reference → test retained-copy and regenerated undo → quantify restoration and spillovers
load_bearing_mechanism: Treat verifier agreement and actual rollback fidelity as separately measured prerequisites for autonomous updates.
limitations_evident: Rollback cannot undo consequences incurred while a bad change was deployed.

title: MemDev-Bench: Does Memory Help Code Agents?Benchmarking Memory Systems over Real Repository Histories
problem: Code-memory evaluations lack temporally valid histories and control of historical-task relevance.
assumption_broken: Earlier repository tasks should be executable and relevance-annotated before memory is compared.
operational_signature: mine prior pull requests → restore historical environments → annotate relevance → build memories → evaluate later tasks
load_bearing_mechanism: Pair real repository histories with controlled relevance to measure helpful and harmful memory reuse.
limitations_evident: Experiments use the Verified subset and one agent/backbone configuration.

title: Beyond Experience: Knowledge-Guided Evolution for NPU Kernel Generation
problem: NPU kernel agents cannot discover mechanisms missing from model pretraining through experience alone.
assumption_broken: External platform evidence can guide every evolutionary proposal, repair and recombination.
operational_signature: index platform knowledge → retrieve evidence pack → seed kernel strategies → execute and repair → recombine winners
load_bearing_mechanism: Condition evolutionary kernel search on version-checked external knowledge filtered by accumulated experience.
limitations_evident: Evaluation covers 53 public Ascend C operators.

title: When Does Experience Memory Help Closed-Loop LLM Driving Agents? A Controlled Evaluation with Resampled Warmup Pools, Token-Matched Fillers, and Audited Baselines
problem: Apparent driving-memory gains may come from favorable warmup draws or extra prompt tokens.
assumption_broken: Warmup memory pools must be resampled and compared with token-matched irrelevant context.
operational_signature: resample memory pools → audit baseline ports → compare filler and memory → price caution → measure robustness
load_bearing_mechanism: Treat the warmup draw as a random factor and use token-matched filler to isolate memory benefit.
limitations_evident: Conclusions are properties of one audited HighwayEnv testbed.

title: MaD-RSI: Model-as-Data for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
problem: Single-model harness optimization overfits model-specific behaviors and repeats adaptation costs.
assumption_broken: Differences among frozen models can be training evidence for one shared harness.
operational_signature: align model executions → select disagreement and coverage evidence → contrast failures and successes → revise shared harness
load_bearing_mechanism: Joint diagnosis uses heterogeneous models' behavioral differences before optimization rather than only testing transfer afterward.
limitations_evident: Evaluation uses a finite set of development and unseen executor models.

title: ChartEvo: Self-Evolving Agent Harnesses for Long-Tail Chart Reasoning
problem: Long-tail charts require visual capabilities and reasoning strategies not covered by fixed tools.
assumption_broken: Reusable tool-call compositions can evolve with chart-specific skills and tools.
operational_signature: diagnose chart failures → evolve skills and tools → validate local toolchains → persist → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Persist validated local tool-call chains and dependencies alongside evolving chart capabilities.
limitations_evident: Evolution is conducted separately on each benchmark's selected long-tail chart types.

title: Evolving Agent Interfaces
problem: Human-designed computer-use interfaces make agents repeat inefficient low-level operations.
assumption_broken: Interface design and usage knowledge can themselves be learned from task experience.
operational_signature: inspect synthetic trajectories → build interface repository → score hidden validation tasks → select repositories → evolve
load_bearing_mechanism: Population-based repository evolution separates unlabeled interface invention from validation-based selection.
limitations_evident: Validation scores guide selection even though the meta-agent does not see validation traces.

title: Training-Free Continual Learning for Multimodal Forecasting via Prompt Evolution
problem: Forecasting adaptation usually requires retraining and in-loop gains can overstate transfer.
assumption_broken: Regime knowledge can live in an editable guidance block around a frozen forecaster.
operational_signature: forecast windows → reflect on errors → gate rewrite → retain per-window Pareto winners → merge complementary guidance
load_bearing_mechanism: Evolve textual forecasting policy under outcome feedback with per-instance frontier retention and untouched monitoring.
limitations_evident: News removal does not harm the guided forecaster
In-loop gains can overstate out-of-loop gains.

title: Auditing the Product, Not the Recursion: The Evaluation Evidence Behind Recursive Self-Improvement Claims
problem: Product evaluations do not establish repeatable or improved improvement procedures.
assumption_broken: Each RSI claim requires a claim-specific evaluation design rather than a final-score comparison.
operational_signature: freeze search frame → code full-text evidence → independently adjudicate → audit improver comparisons → report evidence gaps
load_bearing_mechanism: Distinguish product, repeatability and matched-budget improver evidence in a reproducible full-text census.
limitations_evident: The search frame is arXiv-specific and frozen at a stated date.

title: VisualEvolve: A Skill Self-Evolution Framework for Visual Reasoning
problem: Skill evolution can regress and full accumulated evidence overloads the evolver.
assumption_broken: The starting snapshot and granularity of accessed evidence can be selected rather than fixed.
operational_signature: select library snapshot → execute tasks → inspect evidence coarse-to-fine → revise skills → evaluate and archive
load_bearing_mechanism: Validation-based snapshot selection and progressive evidence access stabilize executable visual-skill evolution.
limitations_evident: The same fixed validation set guides repeated snapshot selection.

title: Which Agent's Skill Should Change? Group-Relative Credit Assignment for Evolving Multi-Agent Teams
problem: Presence of a skill in successful team runs does not establish that it helped.
assumption_broken: Agent-skill credit can come from behavioral contrasts among repeated executions of the same question.
operational_signature: sample grouped team runs → assign relative agent-skill credit → diagnose failure type → aggregate → validate edits
load_bearing_mechanism: Ground responsible-skill edits in group-relative behavioral contrasts rather than trajectory membership.
limitations_evident: Evaluation uses two-agent teams and two open-weight actors.

title: Object-Oriented Harness: Evolving Agent Harnesses through Object-Oriented Design
problem: One global harness poorly serves heterogeneous execution requirements.
assumption_broken: Harnesses can form an inherited class hierarchy with learned task routing.
operational_signature: cluster discovery failures → evolve specialized subclass → retain inherited hierarchy → learn routing lessons → freeze and route
load_bearing_mechanism: Use object-oriented inheritance to preserve reusable harness code while specializing task execution.
limitations_evident: Discovery and held-out tasks are separate within three benchmark domains.

title: Elicitation or Expansion? Demystifying Gains from Agent Harness Optimization
problem: Pass-at-one gains cannot reveal whether harness optimization broadens reachable task coverage.
assumption_broken: Reliability improvements and capability expansion can be distinguished using repeated-attempt coverage.
operational_signature: optimize harness → freeze initial and final versions → repeat test attempts → compare coverage and scaling controls
load_bearing_mechanism: Use pass-at-k and difficulty-stratified comparisons to separate elicitation from expansion.
limitations_evident: Finite attempt budgets only estimate reachable coverage.

title: Training the Whole Agent, Not Just the Model
problem: Policy-only training leaves evolving repair and interaction weaknesses in a fixed harness.
assumption_broken: Training should adapt persistent tools and hooks together with the model rather than only update weights.
operational_signature: inspect current policy traces → generate repair skills and tool edits → gate pass and trainable rates → GRPO train → repeat
load_bearing_mechanism: Train with adaptive skills while co-evolving tools and hooks that remain necessary at deployment.
limitations_evident: Skills are removed at evaluation while evolved tools and hooks remain.

title: Remembering Has a Price: Learning Memory Worth under Resource Constraints
problem: Relevant memories can waste scarce context and interaction budget without helping execution.
assumption_broken: Memory worth should be learned under joint storage, recall and generation constraints.
operational_signature: retrieve candidates → predict query-dependent worth → execute with selected memory → update scorer → manage bounded bank
load_bearing_mechanism: Combine a regularized linear worth scorer and nonlinear residual correction to control both recall and retention.
limitations_evident: Evaluation uses three LifelongAgentBench environments under two deployment settings.
